Increased teacher pay. More funding for public schools. A pay bump for government workers. Investments in mental health services. These are just a few of the legislative priorities Virginia Democrats in the General Assembly secured in this session’s budget.

[_**VA Democrats are delivering on their promises. Will you chip in $5 to elect more Democrats to Congress this year so we can continue to do the same?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85805825/475930776/-853127590?amount=5&refcode=mw_em_240528_2_a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmQwNWJjNi00ZTFkLWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TxtJHlE9SrgOui6_-7L6AX37TitQ7Jfc_ZPwkzfHxqU=)

This budget deal couldn’t be a more perfect reminder of why elections matter. Think about it. Ahead of last year’s elections in the Commonwealth, political pundits everywhere were pretty darn sure that we were going to have a Democratic majority in the Virginia Senate and a Republican majority in the House of Delegates.

You proved them all wrong. You took to the polls and made sure that Democrats took back the House of Delegates. And thanks to you, these results speak for themselves, Derek. Rather than living under an abortion ban in the Commonwealth? We raised teacher pay. Instead of watching the GOP roll back gun safety legislation? We expanded mental health support.

But frankly, I have concerns. When you look at the latest polling, Donald Trump leads Biden in 5 of 6 battleground states. And Democrats running for Senate hold extremely narrow leads in crucial races that could decide Senate control. Sure, I’m worried, but I haven’t given up hope that we can turn this around, because Virginia is _the_ example of what happens when we do. Look at what VA Democrats have accomplished. **Think of what’s possible for our country if Democrats not only re-elected Biden, but expanded our majority in the Senate AND flipped control of the House.**

Heading into this year’s elections, we must remind ourselves that this is the moment where we have to come together and recommit to our mission of electing Democrats who will focus on delivering real results—just like we did here in Virginia.

[_**That’s why I’m personally asking for your help today. clean_body: a perfect reminder of why elections matter | | | = Derek, Increased teacher pay. More funding for public schools. A pay bump for government workers. Investments in mental health services. These are just a few of the legislative priorities Virginia Democrats in the General Assembly secured in this session’s budget. = This budget deal couldn’t be a more perfect reminder of why elections matter. Think about it. Ahead of last year’s elections in the Commonwealth, political pundits everywhere were pretty darn sure that we were going to have a Democratic majority in the Virginia Senate and a Republican majority in the House of Delegates. You proved them all wrong. You took to the polls and made sure that Democrats took back the House of Delegates. And thanks to you, these results speak for themselves, Derek. Rather than living under an abortion ban in the Commonwealth? We raised teacher pay. Instead of watching the GOP roll back gun safety legislation? We expanded mental health support. But frankly, I have concerns. When you look at the latest polling, Donald Trump leads Biden in 5 of 6 battleground states. And Democrats running for Senate hold extremely narrow leads in crucial races that could decide Senate control. Sure, I’m worried, but I haven’t given up hope that we can turn this around, because Virginia is the example of what happens when we do. Look at what VA Democrats have accomplished. Think of what’s possible for our country if Democrats not only re-elected Biden, but expanded our majority in the Senate AND flipped control of the House. Heading into this year’s elections, we must remind ourselves that this is the moment where we have to come together and recommit to our mission of electing Democrats who will focus on delivering real results—just like we did here in Virginia. = Thank you, Mark Warner **= | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

name: Team AOC
subject: Rafah
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians are sheltering in Rafah. On Sunday night, an IDF airstrike on Rafah killed 45 Palestinians and injured dozens more.1
Families in the area are in urgent need of humanitarian support.
**Today, we’re asking you to support frontline organizations that are working around the clock to save lives in Rafah.**
_100% of your donation goes directly to relief efforts on the ground._
**World Central Kitchen** works with a local network of restaurants, food trucks, and emergency kitchens to ensure the swift provision of fresh, nourishing meals to communities after disasters strike. Ongoing attacks have forced them to close their main kitchen in Rafah, but just yesterday, they served over 100,000 meals to impacted families. They are increasing capacity this week, sending 58 aid trucks into Gaza since Sunday’s attack.
**[Donate $5 to World Central Kitchen →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28508?refcode=em20240528-6503-P_FND_CHA_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6503%2E2526796%2ETicI7E)**
**Palestine Children’s Relief Fund** is focused on immediate emergency response, and thanks to overwhelming global support has been providing essential medical supplies, food, medical treatment, clean water, and other necessities for Palestinian families directly affected by this unprecedented humanitarian crisis. They just completed construction on a field hospital in Rafah with 100 beds, a pediatric clinic, and a desalination facility to ensure a study supply of clean water.
**[Donate $5 to Palestine Children’s Relief Fund →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28509?t=2&akid=6503%2E2526796%2ETicI7E)**
Whether or not you can donate today, thank you for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**
These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.
That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

Trump and Rep. Jack Bergman endorsed each other.
Let me explain why this is not good for the 1st District
The mutual endorsement has significant implications for Michigan's 1st District, and not for the better...
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
https://drbob.me/aboutbob [https://drbob.me/aboutbob]
These so-called 'leaders' are out of touch with the needs and values of our district. They have not adequately addressed critical issues such as economic development, healthcare access, and environmental protection.
Tonight, let's show them [drbob.me/aboutbob] that rural America is no longer home to hate, division, and bad policy.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
EXPRESS DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=express_lane_5]

ANOTHER AMOUNT [drbob.me/aboutbob]
We need leaders who prioritize our families, freedoms, and future.
Friends,
Imagine a district with robust infrastructure, reliable connectivity, affordable childcare, and high-quality local education and vocational training. Jobs with livable wages, affordable and available housing, and access to quality healthcare. We need to attract new industries and support local businesses.
Our leaders should recognize the importance of energy independence while protecting the environment and addressing climate change.
Our leaders can no longer be satisfied with our district’s counties being at the top for unemployment, childhood poverty, and wages that aren’t sufficient for a middle-class life.
We need leaders who can anticipate problems before they are felt, like having three of the oldest counties in the nation, not as a retirement mecca but because of a lack of jobs for our youth to stay.
We need leaders who believe in democracy, not its subversion.
We need leaders who treat everyone with decency and respect, who can admit mistakes, and who strive to unite us rather than divide us. Trump and Bergman are disconnected from these core needs and values.
Let's seize this opportunity to mobilize and elect people who truly understand and champion our local issues. That’s my goal; to be that leader - to champion our rural way of life.
Join me with a contribution and help us defeat Trumpism. Help us drive positive change at the community level and build a brighter future for Michigan's 1st District.
Friends, with you in my corner, they can be defeated!
With deep gratitude,
-Bob

Democrat, MI01

body:
Here’s an update from another busy week. | | | | |
---
| Happy Tuesday!
Here’s an update from another busy week.
**Memorial Day in Burlington and Rochester** On Memorial Day, we remember, honor, and pay tribute to our nation’s service members who gave the ultimate sacrifice. This year, I spent my Memorial Day in Burlington and Rochester.
We kicked things off with a great crew at the Burlington Memorial Day Parade.
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| Then, I was honored to join the many service members, veterans, and families at Veterans Park for the Memorial Day Ceremony.
---
| Then, we were on to our next stop in Rochester.
This year, Rochester hosted their 158th consecutive Memorial Day Celebration. It was a privilege to attend their historic Memorial Day parade!
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| **Racine St. Catherine’s Commencement** Last Friday, I had the honor of being the commencement speaker for Racine St. Catherine’s Class of 2024. These graduates are entering a world in a state of immense and fast change, but also a time of tremendous opportunity and great challenge.
I reminded the graduates that much more unites us than divides us. And today’s challenges will not stand in your way if you focus on your goals. Our divisions are not so deep that the American dream is gone forever.
The Racine St. Catherine’s Class of 2024 is an impressive bunch, and they make me optimistic about the future of our nation!
---
| **Getting Results in Washington** Last week, my committee passed a bill that requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote nationally in an effort to prevent non-citizens from voting in federal elections.
I'm committed to ensuring Americans have confidence in their elections. Preventing noncitizen voting and foreign influence in our elections is a critical component of restoring trust in our elections.
---

As a wife, a mother, and a Child of God- prayer is the centerpiece of my life.

I also prayed for the courage & strength to do something I struggle at- asking others for help.

After years of dividing our nation by the color of our skin, gender, and our economic status, they know they can't suffer another humiliating defeat by someone like me who uses God's guiding hand to bring people together & mend that divide.

name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb9qfn23vhod67eealu0g292csahm6jq6teoelug_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjjm6o76c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc71qmu2c33sphs5le0gffsv2t79s4pp534j7r28_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjjm6o76c5h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zips0vdftlel9eskikff5fcv6q03340tc5np1cd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjjm6o76c5h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4ua7mmmvqve9s4nokm9tqsdprlkded3kd7ic0f0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjjm6o76c5h2bs)**

| MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- Trump-endorsed candidate for Congress, Trump Virginia State Director, former Navy SEAL, and state Senator John McGuire announced that he has been endorsed by the Godzilla of Truth, John Fredericks.
Read Fredericks' announcement, McGuire's statement, and Trump's statement below.

Huge Endorsement Announcement! John Fredericks Endorses John McGuire For Congress In VA-05 #GodzillaOfTruth #TruckingTheTruth #OracleOfDeplorables
MANAKIN SABOT, Virginia--I am proud to stand today with President Trump in endorsing State Sen. John McGuire in Virginia's Fifth District Republican primary.
John is running against two-term Republican incumbent Bob Good, chairman of the Freedom Caucus in the U.S. House.
While early voting commenced several weeks ago and the game day vote is June 18, I urge my listeners and viewers who have not yet voted to consider voting for McGuire for Congress.
Simply put, John McGuire has President Trump's back. Always has. Always will.
President Trump unequivocally endorsed Sen. McGuire for Congress (see his Truth Social post below).
I respect what Rep. Good has done as chair of the Freedom Caucus, and as such I have remained neutral in this race.
Until now.
I said it before and I will say it again: President Trump is our presumptive nominee, and he has gone through pure hell since this campaign began.
President Trump has earned the right to call the play and pick the team he wants on the field advancing his agenda.
That is why I stand with John McGuire in Virginia's 5th district.
I have known and supported John for a long time, and most recently endorsed his run for Virginia Senate and campaigned for him around the district.
John is a proven and unwavering America First and MAGA patriot, a Navy SEAL who has been on the frontlines in the fight against the cartels in South America, and he can be counted on to support President Trump and go to the wall for his legislative agenda to save America.
When the chips are down, McGuire is there for President Trump. He's never wavered. He never will.

McGuire said:
"Thank you to John Fredericks for joining with President Donald J. Trump and the MAGA movement to support my campaign for Congress! I've been with Trump since he came down the escalator and when I'm in Congress, I'll back his agenda and put America First. Trump is exactly right about Bob Good. Our country is in dire peril under Biden and we need Trump to Save America. We cannot trust Bob Good. Trump has recognized that I'm the 100% MAGA candidate in this race and I appreciate it. I'm ready to give everything I've got to represent the 5th District effectively and aggressively. Let's crack down on the border, keep woke ideologies out of schools, and protect our crucial 2nd Amendment. President Trump and I will be the voice of We the People in Washington. Please vote McGuire in the June 18 primary!"

President Trump [said (click here)](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001v3DXt99oENQ-miZ4PYtKEIj46zMJxBxJn_-QF8V0Ib5zL-_QICs6ZBHOh36WN6_3Pn9w6hOcvAxASWiGKuZb8LRKGCYDTRzGcJwrvZwtx79m-a9ObIWCJ6AG53ASANfnQYL_ig3uBLIoAJ3bKUnIuPFb3bFU0XitwqnAWPJ-5u1kxnuFVcCRUP7qn9GeHoBLau8pevCjJvM=&c=xVFsiqrJjWRHYP-AMgQo3X6evCboEARjOlE_z4zre0ZWBENcqoAAuw==&ch=_vppM3RC1OmBddIMPNAtyW0wWXj7Jvrxnn35vVAVGz0q_bi773QZRQ==):
"Bob Good is BAD FOR VIRGINIA, AND BAD FOR THE USA. He turned his back on our incredible movement, and was constantly attacking and fighting me until recently, when he gave a warm and "loving" Endorsement - But really, it was too late. The damage had been done! I just want to MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN, and the person that can most help me do that is Navy SEAL and highly respected State Legislator, John McGuire, a true American Hero. John, who fought the Cartels on the Front Line, and then came home and fought the drug dealers in Virginia, will ALWAYS PUT AMERICA FIRST. I had the safest Border in history, built hundreds of miles of Wall, and then Crooked Joe Biden came along and ruined it, making it one of the worst human catastrophes ever in our Country. John and I will correct this situation, and fast! He is strong on crime, will protect our great Military/Vets, and will always defend our under siege Second Amendment. John McGuire has my Complete and Total Endorsement! MAGA2024"

DENTIST’S “JAW-DROPPING” TRICKSTOPS YOUR SNORING FOR GOOD... THE VERY FIRST NIGHT YOU TRY IT!

** ** More than 1.5 million Americans — many who were “extreme snorers” their entire life — have suddenly stopped snoring thanks to this dentist... and now you can do it too!
** ** If you or your partner **snores** at night, **do not ignore it.**
** ** New information about the **risks of snoring** has doctors across the country urging patients to take their snoring more seriously...**
** ** This is especially true if the **snoring is LOUD** , or you’re **over the age of 40.**
** ** Because “sawing logs” isn’t _JUST_ obnoxious for you and your partner...
** ** It doesn’t _JUST_ ruin your sleep, leaving you tired and cranky...
** ** According to recent studies, for some unlucky people...
** ****Snoring may ALSO be a “hidden death sentence”.**
** ** Recently, clinical studies found that snoring is associated with **increased risk of serious health issues** , including:
---
❌ Decreased blood oxygen levels (hypoxia) ❌ Heart attack ❌ High blood pressure ❌ Stroke ❌ Type 2 diabetes
---
** ** That’s in addition to the consequences we already knew about:
** ****Difficulty concentrating... fatigue... stress... overall poor sleep quality...** the list goes on.
** ** So if you or your loved one snores, the studies and medical experts agree: **You need to find a way to stop snoring — ASAP**. IF YOU SNORE, DON’T WORRY...YOU’RE ABOUT TO GETVERY GOOD NEWS!

---
✔️ Healthier oxygen levels ✔️ More energy throughout the day ✔️ Improved concentration and memory ✔️ Better overall health & wellbeing
---
These benefits can completely change your life... and once you fix your snoring, they come _FAST!_ So if you snore... or your loved one snores... then you have so much to gain by stopping — and it could even help you **enjoy a longer, happier life.** Best of all, it’s now **easier than ever for you to stop snoring...**** Thanks to this dentist’s breakthrough discovery.**

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjualenp94updmbig3v8ccgl0d64bvlqhot9b5d0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjjm1or1cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5soe5n4pv06fd64hnfn4ldrd83molubjuibr1co_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge8pj4c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zevrudu3pqq7h8o86kamujd60qfhiislfp89iha0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge8pj4c9h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj0s730qa5ourdu3ife3k9pv1bdadc0esrmahda8_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge8pj4c9h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. name: Tim Ballard
subject: I can't forget their faces
body:
I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom.” But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm35i1loudhojj7dnftgtqg20brls3f2nhh3seng_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)
---
I see the victims’ faces every time I close my eyes. _“Why, Heavenly Father?”_ I ask God each night. **[I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom” and I later went on to serve on President Trump’s human trafficking advisory board.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zklvpff4m4h66g0mt7ab6j0sbj0hn4m33bptc698_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)** It is hard to describe the full picture on the silver screen or even tell the President of the United States in a humane way. What I have witnessed will scar you for life. Going into the lion’s den time and time again as an undercover operator is by far the hardest thing I have ever done. **[**But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1k2sedm1fuh22nt6k9ah7hunpru9poih36dqk6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)**
---
[**STAND WITH ME**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5mn8v2mvtglcbbhu4vkfmjodrv6g9lgqm08lm40_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)
---
This persecution is already taking a toll. Operations to rescue women and children on three different continents have been destroyed. We can’t let this go on any longer. It’s time to take a stand and finally direct resources toward their highest value. Though I am persecuted, I know I am not alone. God is with me. The truth is with me. _**[**I hope you are with me, too.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqk0b4r7ek9ucg2lmpv1kkuecoffbub8mi4be13g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)**_
---

---
_**[_**I am humbly asking for your support today. Will you please sign the petition to help me stand up to the forces attempting to silence me?**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zskfq4i1epe4m5rpskudm2vljolunvenbcp4v7rg_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge4oj6cph2bs)**_ With your help and God’s grace, I know we will be victorious. subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zu381bmf2909s7437ks838losv3ns1n192fvl318_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge2o34c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjdrdo9qbqc28i4mhn4kgf3oufmin5pvv6d4dr9g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjge2o34c5h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

## DNC to Virtually Nominate Biden
The Democratic National Committee plans to [virtually nominate President Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8GOiJYA8YFxWvc5bVXWhiWsBGGKEGO7u9PufrqGWmk-bpu10CV2u1_ONCP3LcQB524GQGLAL1pnnxGBJw4ejUruzgrleLF5-wmvc-wQ1DozBJl0nOa52k36GJUnDxI0NLAIp2xarok2IN1wUU0RqusmJaYaPTn5d6pjYK5fvcTn5fYD159GePxYtM_BiuDdRQsVOuHMVhLP7Dh-8VgjeF4BLo1Bqu2brGTEfeOYqeETaQWRS_UxR5q7UPE3k5sg_pH50-fHm-qlV52ZlrejkC_AT7-XnF6-AkAAP__llxg_A) ahead of the party's August convention, allowing Biden to appear on the November ballot in Ohio. Ohio law requires political parties to certify presidential nominees [90 days before](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHu2yAQgPGnwRsRPgPGA0MXb-na0TrDOb4Eg4VRorx91c7_-Rs-6ffnvtyRE-fHbzzIt60sGBq_aTESJgl60V30GxHQ0JHvx95Ozqq-73avQpjCEEYzqThG48is2qw42AmsG9atYw8KtDIwKWdsP9wirGgdukDG6H7rhVYUuZV6exbObactfcub6i2Uo0t-b-28xPBLwCxgbjvtnNK_JmDey0GZPpeAOeBxIj-ygFlb5yZr5VYxv2TCWi6SZeciX7mE1yUjHSVUbBzkibV95bOQXDlSliumVJqMhDFxJgFzV308P5wSX3YUWj0O5P__rv0s9fbwNwAA__9gr2y1) November's election. However, the DNC scheduled its convention for August 19-22, more than a week after Ohio's August 7 deadline. A DNC committee is [expected to meet next week](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vgzAQQH8NbET2-QsGD12ypWtHdD4f4SoHR2AR9d9X6dzx6Q1Pel-3-YZSZLt_4oNjW-qM1OTk2Q0wDWBn2-e4MAObnqMO2k-jV1r3ayQMi3LI6NBTzkEFSIQpm-CDt2h7iaDAKgeTGp3X5pIhoR9xJHbO6kV3VnGWVvfLd5WtrbyUn3ryfqH66EtcW3senfno4NrBFZ8bv463esPehAp3cK2r1CFhKbUNSTJvAxLxcQwmLcZNRDxyMEHbxNZRmib0bLSzvt9jfr6kFDl86Ky6P1DKX7n9_-GM8BsAAP__oaJe2g) and approve the virtual proceedings, and all members will vote on the change sometime before Ohio's August 7 ballot deadline. The DNC's announcement was made [on the same day](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGP3CAUBOBfgzsseAbbW1BkFbnbKFGKlBaG5_WLMCDDrnX__uSrr5qRpprv32N-WAoUn7_sjqauabau0htnzeHGQc2q8WZFBOwaNHKQ_W3shZTNZkZtlXRe6H5wowOFsC5WK70MWgjdQ0MGBCih4SZG3cuu9bDYfrSjQ62VXCVTAj3VdLT_E8W64Ro-0huP1qW9CWarNRfW_WAwMZjO82z3Eq-NwYSRvwqDKeJ5RU6BKrmrpo0SLxhtRZ5tKVj4M2Ue0POFPEa-2BBS5dY5LIUvFAI_qW7pVbnHPbnD1sLLK-d0VAaTPfj9LqP7Pf1h3ZQcedb9vF9ieJa_eOTmMD6fFAKVfmBKPHdL4etC_R70beAzAAD__xHcepc) that Ohio's Republican governor called a special legislative session to address the issue.
## T-Mobile to Buy U.S. Cellular for $4.4 Billion
T-Mobile agreed to [purchase U.S. Cellular's wireless](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQRb8GOiwYA8YFxWvc7WtTWhiGXaLxsrJZO_n7yKnTXelK5-h83OZbKFSe9_9hRd9ynUNs5cDZCBgF6Fnz5DMiYM_Rq0HZ0VmpFH_4vFinU7ZmWIbc2-BUdGbQoILSOeaRFw8StDQwSmes6rsES7AuuIjGaJUV0xJTaXXrPmt5tgdm-q4Hbl2sKyf_aO21s_4fg4nBdJ5nF75K3a-XwXSxGUzSXNsxmJpY61IIxXsXEYneFDaRMBDffHqdhajsdmBa3tdQ6NfR_i4-PPwEAAD__8KPVps) operations, customers, stores, and select spectrum assets for $4.4 billion Tuesday, with the deal expected to close next year. body:
I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film "Sound of Freedom." But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=633752adca7945e8be8a341586fa7a3a&_e=cp-Np2U0YlhT2Be1yUx2Kw4Cp1seD-KffeSzSgPCDaJD0Tz7NZLz_J2buvaMFweszB46DmKtwgEPQLwZMSFO-ijNr02v-L57js0hXYCqA1CznkQgxS7mnb-uM3dSDoXCHNmUjRX5JNcGioTYAsTcxL2oirZqqPIIXKgt3HoJJdoWAtJeZCoHdynkYMETaWjylwZVPR_3ieCoAQUjMd2bPxUjFY9F3XLE3zCapic5AjLuiW3YToQT11ec776TeQkrtgYSw-4f3OPF-UzTlV5EQaxM9yRa9uZQv8pKS60LNZYkitOxrtGIHM8xgGNTLghkNCe--j8_5VEzPCHpO3EO_Qhj8X90NF0crN35_gYAPHRiJxB67v7mKTFyE3NqxhdvrSnXWZSOGyi3KEey4gSUtX3ljaQdqXozuId7AcWsXknym3M1f4OtATPnDwVxKmFw)
---
I see the victims' faces every time I close my eyes. _" Why, Heavenly Father?"_ I ask God each night. **[I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film"Sound of Freedom" and I later went on to serve on President Trump's human trafficking advisory board.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=633752adca7945e8be8a341586fa7a3a&_e=cp-Np2U0YlhT2Be1yUx2Kw4Cp1seD-KffeSzSgPCDaJD0Tz7NZLz_J2buvaMFweszB46DmKtwgEPQLwZMSFO-ijNr02v-L57js0hXYCqA1CznkQgxS7mnb-uM3dSDoXCHNmUjRX5JNcGioTYAsTcxL2oirZqqPIIXKgt3HoJJdoWAtJeZCoHdynkYMETaWjylwZVPR_3ieCoAQUjMd2bPxUjFY9F3XLE3zCapic5AjLuiW3YToQT11ec776TeQkrtgYSw-4f3OPF-UzTlV5EQaxM9yRa9uZQv8pKS60LNZaURn7vScsaoxZvUFtBf_093E75-SpL_zoE-npryqNrUHQ0mSpjiWIBRNi7ufOeZP8SqSebMjFjYSIKkxqFjcaYZYzQV96Ko5q9RjFPuXyvrekko-vAmHqhWl0vSWlYXkVDQB1_aQ7dfuN5_rT1QOjg)** It is hard to describe the full picture on the silver screen or even tell the President of the United States in a humane way. What I have witnessed will scar you for life. Going into the lion's den time and time again as an undercover operator is by far the hardest thing I have ever done. **[**But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=633752adca7945e8be8a341586fa7a3a&_e=cp-Np2U0YlhT2Be1yUx2Kw4Cp1seD-KffeSzSgPCDaJD0Tz7NZLz_J2buvaMFweszB46DmKtwgEPQLwZMSFO-ijNr02v-L57js0hXYCqA1CznkQgxS7mnb-uM3dSDoXCHNmUjRX5JNcGioTYAsTcxL2oirZqqPIIXKgt3HoJJdoWAtJeZCoHdynkYMETaWjylwZVPR_3ieCoAQUjMd2bPxUjFY9F3XLE3zCapic5AjLuiW3YToQT11ec776TeQkrtgYSw-4f3OPF-UzTlV5EQaxM9yRa9uZQv8pKS60LNZYEWECa_naicgGe1uTEw6Mvs1E4F4vxHBzY2FBSP1tHuvSzK-M8sAwmz-uDUvMtvpuxgyQrw3uKFueClA-HTniHps3qUWBlZCqILBF40pOFX-mJ1Juj4K100pmnlHH92cR63qw5ikaXBXio9qUrLd_8)**

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. clean_body: Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called " The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of " The Second World Wars" on DVD: Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College P.S. The " The Second World Wars" DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. Conservatives Give PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

The Republican Party of Waukesha County and the Republican Party of Wisconsin were honored to host President Donald Trump on May 1st for an incredible rally! Wisconsinites are ready for a change and plan to re-elect the People's President in November. **Milwaukee County**
The Republican Party of Milwaukee County hosted an awesome tabling event during Cinco de Mayo celebrations! **Monroe County**
Members of the Republican Party of Monroe County have been going non-stop! First, they were joined by local representatives at their Conservative Breakfast to discuss nomination signing papers. They then headed out to post signs for Eric Hovde around the county! **Kenosha County**
The Republican Party of Kenosha County hosted a dinner to show appreciation for their poll workers and observers. We at the Republican Party of Wisconsin are incredibly grateful for all our amazing volunteers. **Green County**
The Green County Republican Party held their annual Lincoln Day Dinner on Saturday, May 11th to a capacity crowd. Special guest speakers included Congressman Glenn Grothman, Judge Brad Schimel, and RPW Chairman Brian Schimming. It was a wonderful evening to celebrate all things Republican and to honor the legacy of Abraham Lincoln. **Wood County**
The Republican Party of Wood County), along with RPW, held its first Nomination Signing Drive Through Event, with a special mascot! Wood County is looking forward to hosting more events, as the election season continues. **Racine County**
The Republican Party of Racine County held a candidate signing event in Burlington this past Saturday. Members will be in downtown Racine next Saturday for another opportunity to sign nomination papers and meet Congressman Steil. Watch for details. **Outagamie County**
The Republican Party of Outagamie County has made a tremendous effort in connecting its members with local candidates who aspire to effect positive change in the area. **Rock County**
The Republican Party of Rock County joined in on Cinco de Mayo celebrations to spread the Republican message and garner signatures for upcoming elections! **Walworth County**
The Republican Party of Walworth County had a wonderful weekend at Delavan's Cinco de Mayo festival. Over 400 lit bags and 800 stickers were handed out, and members had incredible conversations with booth visitors. **St. Croix County**
Members of the Republican Party of St. Croix County showed up to the New Richmond Car Show to gather candidate signatures for the November ballot. **Dodge County**
Another Great turnout at the Red Moon near Rubicon for the Republican Party of Dodge County Conservative Breakfast Gathering. Thank you to to District Attorney Andrea Will, Rep. Mark Born, Rep. Barbara Dittrich & Members of the Dodge County Republican Party. **Calumet County**
The Republican Party of Calumet County held their 2nd Amendment Raffle last weekend! **Door County**
The Republican Party of Door County had a successful Lincoln Day Dinner at The Log Den in Egg Harbor! Excellent job by Tawsif Anam speaking on the issue of Illegal immigration. Members also heard from three congressional candidates, Roger Roth, Tony Wied, and Andre Jacque, plus our Assemblyman Joel Kitchens, and RPW Chairman Brian Schimming. **Richland County**
The Republican Party of Richland County was joined by Wisconsin State Senator Joan Ballweg at their latest membership meeting. **Dodge County**
The Republican Party of Dodge County hosted their monthly Breakfast Gathering at the Red Moon! Even when the Senate of Virginia put me in a plexiglass box because I refused to mask up and get the covid shot, I stood strong.

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/kaYWYc36YL1IBCXTtqiGag~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOZ_) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**

name: Sarah DeValkenaere
subject: In prison for saving a life
body:
Dear Friend,

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMAMaQdpZX88PDiswSqemA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOaByP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi81NGVlMTJmMi03MjBjLTQ1OGEtODczYS02NjE4ZmQxNjI1MmU_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNTI5X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmVQQIV2YJbjc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
That's a picture of me and my husband, Eric, so you at least know what we look like.

Eric is a Detective with the Kansas City Police Department.

I wanted to send a picture of us with our three beautiful children - but in this current political climate, I don't feel safe sharing photos of our kids on the Internet.

When I tell you what happened, I think you'll understand. **[And I pray that you'll find it in your heart to help me save my husband.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMAMaQdpZX88PDiswSqemA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOaByP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi81NGVlMTJmMi03MjBjLTQ1OGEtODczYS02NjE4ZmQxNjI1MmU_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNTI5X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmVQQIV2YJbjc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

You see, it all started in early December - a few weeks before Christmas.

One of Eric's fellow detectives witnessed two vehicles speeding through the city streets - one was clearly chasing the other - and the police helicopter quickly got involved. A spotter in the helicopter was able to locate the suspect in a red pickup truck... still speeding down city streets.

The driver, 26-year-old Cameron Lamb, was chasing his ex-girlfriend in a stolen truck - weaving across lanes and running through stoplights.

My husband and his partner responded to the call and caught up with the suspect as he attempted to back the stolen truck into a garage.

Both detectives got out of their police vehicles and approached the stolen truck while repeatedly ordering the suspect to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS.

That's when it happened.

**As Eric 's partner approached the driver's side, the suspect reached into his waistband and pulled out a handgun - pointing it directly at the detective.**

**My husband 's police training kicked in.**

He fired four rounds in the direction of the suspect through the truck's front windshield. The truck continued traveling into the garage where it finally came to a stop.

When officers entered, they found the suspect deceased - his arm hanging out the open window with a .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground below.

That night, when Eric returned home, I hugged him and burst into tears. I was so thankful he was safe - and hopeful we could move forward and put this episode behind us.

But it didn't end there.

Several months later, the local prosecutor _charged Eric with MANSLAUGHTER and Armed Criminal Action._

I was in shock.

Then late last year, my husband finally went to trial. The judge ruled against him - and Eric was sentenced to 6 years in prison.

Now you understand why I'm asking for your help.

My husband is an honest man of integrity who followed in his father's law enforcement footsteps. Eric himself is a decorated, 21-year veteran of the Kansas City Police Department.

He's a role model in our community - a Little League baseball coach, a tireless volunteer, and a loving husband and father.

My husband is a hero.

But it didn't matter to the prosecutor that the suspect recklessly swerved a stolen truck through city streets... that he was violent toward his ex-girlfriend and endangered the lives of her two children... that he pointed a stolen gun directly at a police officer.

For serving our community for over 20 years - and risking his life - my has been shipped to an out-of-state prison.

And since the Missouri Supreme Court recently declined to take up Eric's case, that's where he'll stay for the next six years unless he receives a pardon from the Governor of Missouri. He'll miss our wedding anniversaries, our children's birthdays, their graduations(?), and our home will be left without the father and husband we love.

Even if Eric's good name is eventually cleared, just thinking about the cost of his defense and now our efforts to get him pardoned is overwhelming...

... but thank God we got a call from Jason Johnson, President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

If you've ever heard of LELDF you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly accused police officers like Eric.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments.

And with the thought of trying to suddenly raise our three children alone - I was certainly at one of the lowest moments of my life.

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help provide Eric with the best possible legal defense, but now they're helping us launch a nationwide petition campaign urging Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric.

But as a non-profit organization, they depend solely on generous gifts from folks like you to defend officers like Eric.

I truly believe God is using Jason and the LELDF to answer our prayers.

That's because my husband and I are not wealthy people. I'm a kindergarten teacher and Eric is a career cop.

So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone.

**Will you donate[$35 or any amount to LELDF today to help save my husband?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMAMaQdpZX88PDiswSqemA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOaByP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi81NGVlMTJmMi03MjBjLTQ1OGEtODczYS02NjE4ZmQxNjI1MmU_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNTI5X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmVQQIV2YJbjc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I am so scared for Eric and I will do whatever I can for him - and for our children.

**[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMAMaQdpZX88PDiswSqemA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOaByP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi81NGVlMTJmMi03MjBjLTQ1OGEtODczYS02NjE4ZmQxNjI1MmU_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNTI5X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmVQQIV2YJbjc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Eric and I - and our three kids - are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help bring Eric home where he belongs.

No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Sarah DeValkenaere

P.S. The Missouri Supreme Court has declined to take Eric's case. Now a pardon is one of the last remaining options to bring Eric home. We're feverishly trying to raise the money to pay for a massive petition drive urging the Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric. I know my husband is innocent. But it's so hard to be a cop these days. The 'defund the police' movement has wiped out the support officers like Eric need to do their jobs.

And dozens of prosecutors across the country have made it a priority to try and lock up as many cops as they can. Even if they followed their training or defended themselves in the line of duty. The brave men and women in blue need to know that someone... anyone still has their back.

**[That's why I sincerely hope you'll help me get justice for Eric - and our entire family - by making a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the LELDF today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qMAMaQdpZX88PDiswSqemA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoOaByP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi81NGVlMTJmMi03MjBjLTQ1OGEtODczYS02NjE4ZmQxNjI1MmU_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNTI5X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmVQQIV2YJbjc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Thank you, and God bless!
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Howdy folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, May 29, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[There is a modern space race and this time more than the moon is at stake](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The U.S. military's plan to transfer possibly hundreds of Colorado Air National Guard members involved in space operations to the Space Force is facing pushback from Gov. Jared Polis, The Denver Post reports.
In Colorado, it could mean guard members under Polis' authority move to the federal military service. The U.S. Space Command is headquartered in Colorado Springs.
The recent public statements and military preparations underscore a critical realization: space is not just a backdrop for scientific exploration but a potential future battlefield that is integral to national security. As adversaries continue to develop their capabilities, the U.S. is set on ensuring that its interests and assets in space are well protected, maintaining its longstanding role as a leader in space technology and defense.
As this new chapter in military strategy unfolds, the implications for global security and the rules of engagement in space are still being written. The U.S. aims not just to respond to emerging threats but to actively shape the future of military conduct in the vast, final frontier.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[School district turns to AI to solve bus driver shortage, add convenience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS NEWS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Springs School District 11, facing a [severe shortage of bus drivers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), adopted AI technology from HopSkipDrive to optimize bus routes, addressing a 15.1% national driver shortfall since 2019.
* The AI, called [RouteWise AI](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), quickly creates efficient routes by analyzing available vehicles and school locations, producing drafts within hours and finalizing routes over a weekend.
* The use of AI has allowed the district to reduce its bus routes by nearly 50%, improve bus punctuality, and increase driver wages, [saving over half a million dollars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the process. This integration of AI with a rideshare service provides parents with [real-time updates on their children's rides](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), enhancing safety and communication.
* The savings from the AI implementation helped [protect at least ten teaching positions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), demonstrating the technology's broader impact on educational quality.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[New technology may help find missing people in Colorado's backcountry within minutes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Highland Helicopters is testing [Lifeseeker](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a new technology that can quickly locate cell phones in Colorado's backcountry, enhancing search and rescue operations. In a test, rescuers located two missing individuals within just over two minutes.
* The device functions like a [mini cellphone tower](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), attaching to helicopters to pinpoint cellphone locations within a 3-mile radius, and can be installed in about three minutes.
* Lifeseeker [allows search and rescue teams to communicate with located individuals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), sending safety instructions directly to their phones and can also broadcast messages to multiple people, warning them of imminent dangers like wildfires.
* The technology is most effective if the missing person's phone is on, as turning off the phone to save battery--a common practice--limits the technology's ability to [detect the phone](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Lt. Gov. Dianne Primavera released from hospital Monday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Lt. Gov. Dianne Primavera was [released from the hospital](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after receiving treatment for an arm infection and returned home on Memorial Day.
* In a statement, Primavera expressed gratitude for the medical care she received and eagerness to continue her work with Governor Polis, particularly in [ensuring accessible, high-quality healthcare](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for Coloradans.
* Primavera, serving her second term as [Colorado's 50th Lieutenant Governor](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), leads several state offices and initiatives, including healthcare affordability, eHealth innovation, and aerospace and defense.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump trial: Defense slams Cohen as'greatest liar of all time' in closing arguments, protesters scuffle outside](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Closing arguments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are taking place in Donald Trump's trial over allegations linked to a $130,000 payment to Stormy Daniels before the 2016 election, with Trump pleading not guilty to all 34 counts.
* Trump's defense emphasizes his comprehensive duties and posits that the busy nature of his role likely shielded him from the specific details of the financial transactions [managed by his former lawyer](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Michael Cohen, underscoring his commitment to precise financial oversight in his operations.
* The trial has attracted [significant public attention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), drawing comments from high-profile figures and demonstrations from supporters, reflecting the polarized views surrounding the case.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Commentary: Biden's indifference to Americans' plight of soaring food prices is appalling](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY EJ ANTONI, [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_If you 're having trouble affording groceries, don't expect sympathy from the White House._
_In a recent interview, President Joe Biden was told that food prices are up more than 30% on his watch. But he casually dismissed this fact, claiming people have money to pay those elevated prices._ _This doesn 't just demonstrate Biden's tone-deafness to the plight of Americans who struggle to afford necessities like groceries; it shows his ignorance of his own administration's data._
_According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, average weekly paychecks have increased about $150 under Biden, or 14.1% in roughly three years. Normally, that would be cause for celebration, but not in the inflationary environment of "Bidenomics."_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Bills Signed By Governor Polis This Week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF** **| STATE | MAY 26** _Colorado Governor Jared Polis has been active in signing multiple bills into law, including one aimed at implementing comprehensive guidelines for funeral facilities.___
**[Moriarty: Democrats' Colorado Energy story has a bad ending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY TOM MORIARTY****| COMMENTARY | MAY 26** _Colorado Governor Jared Polis and the Colorado democrats tell us a story about fossil fuels. This story has three parts: fossil fuels are bad, the democrats have a plan to eliminate fossil fuels, and their plan is working._
**[Applegate: Possible solutions for El Paso County's immigration problem](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY CORY APPLEGATE****| COMMENTARY | MAY 24** _El Paso County recently saw two busloads of immigrants here illegally come down from Denver. Since Denver 's sanctuary city policies create their own fiscal burden, they now claim they cannot afford to keep taking care of lawbreakers they attracted in the first place. The hospitals in the Denver area gave away $136 million in care last year, which will never be paid back by those with no income or insurance._

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/IEkZetDWfIVrv_EPfbOkZw~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

President Biden made clear that invading Rafah was a Red Line he would not tolerate. Yet, as Israel continues to bombard Rafah, force its evacuation, and kill dozens of Palestinians, that alleged Red Line seems nowhere to be found and [the White House says it has not yet been crossed](https://substack.com/redirect/01681b67-5ba8-4c68-ba64-03cbcb1361a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Here are the four facts that we cannot ignore if we are serious about protecting Palestinians from continued mass murder and suffering, and Israel is held accountable to international human rights law. **Let 's Address This.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ae8yhNKgH3okucTW_nXXjZ4Yut7b6cvlVX_0eCZLWbo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145083108)
1. **Israel is repeatedly bombing Rafah in violation of Biden 's Red Line, but to no avail from Biden to enforce his Red Line**

On May 27, a horrifying Israeli attack on a Rafah tent camp killed 45 Palestinians, burning dozens of children to death, reducing them to ash. As Reuters [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/6f76ac7c-95ae-4a27-b70c-7e3690b0e14d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Survivors said families were preparing to sleep when the strike hit the Tel Al-Sultan neighbourhood where thousands were sheltering after Israeli forces began a [ground offensive](https://substack.com/redirect/bfc14c4f-c359-4233-b610-60989adbd4fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the east of Rafah over two weeks ago. "We were praying... and we were getting our children's beds ready to sleep. There was nothing unusual, then we heard a very loud noise, and fire erupted around us," said Umm Mohamed Al-Attar, a Palestinian mother in a red headscarf. "All the children started screaming... The sound was terrifying; we felt like the metal was about to collapse on us, and shrapnel fell into the rooms."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7748f17d-3e57-4eba-a937-f21c7871f6dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[A designated area for displaced people burns after an Israeli strike, Rafah, southern Gaza, Palestine, May 26, 2024. (Reuters Photo)](https://substack.com/redirect/83274069-ce80-4c42-b5a4-ba4801608eed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Moreover, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and the Israeli military then gave conflicting accounts of what happened--with Netanyahu claiming it was an error and the Israeli military claiming it was planned and legitimate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e168fd02-7a70-4b37-83b4-6b9acc71eeef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f16f32e4-95d2-44d4-854c-2ccfe9a6e04b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's anyone's guess who is lying and who is telling the truth. What's clear is the Israeli government's inability to tell the truth further demonstrates why the United States and all UN members must stop arming the Israeli military and stop enabling these war crimes. Furthermore, apparently not content with the May 27th mass murder, the Israeli military then bombed and killed 21 more Palestinians on May 28th. Al Jazeera [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/872e9823-c4b3-4b3f-b3b2-52720229f220?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> At least 21 people have been killed in Israeli attacks on a tent camp housing displaced families in al-Mawasi, near Gaza's southern city of Rafah, according to Palestinian medical officials and the official Palestinian news agency, days after an Israeli strike on another camp drew global condemnation. At least 12 of those killed in the attacks in Rafah governorate on Tuesday were women.
Perhaps most egregious about these attacks--particularly for the attack that killed 32 children--is that Palestinians were in a designated safe zone. A safe zone they were only in because the Israeli military forced them to move to that area with the promise that they would not be bombed. To rewind, [on May 7 I wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/2da70f7a-4d60-43fa-a2b3-c7443e2f04b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> ...as [NBC](https://substack.com/redirect/9bc7548b-f04e-4873-ab4b-4245a1de8fe7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [NYT](https://substack.com/redirect/64c2a2fe-38b0-4ec3-b530-3f3658fc1d27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have documented, on more than 200 occasions the Israeli Military ordered Palestinian civilians to move to "safe zones" that would be protected from bombing--only to bomb those exact locations hours later with 2000 pound bombs. Such a horrific act committed more than 200 times is not an accident, it is policy. _What assurance can Palestinians have that this forced movement to more concentrated parts of Rafah is not another such cruel and illegal ploy to maximize harm upon and death of Palestinians?_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/744c54db-d303-4b5e-838f-d5e34e40c234?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Israel's horrific bombing answered that question. And the answer is: Palestinians can have no assurance that Israel will not bomb them, even in a safe zone, because the Israeli military has proven it cannot be trusted to uphold its word. And thus, by continuing to trust a government that clearly has no intention of being truthful, and not enforcing its Red Line, the United States continues to be complicit in these mass murders, and continues isolate itself on the global stage.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ae8yhNKgH3okucTW_nXXjZ4Yut7b6cvlVX_0eCZLWbo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145083108)
2. **By continuing to defend Israel 's attacks on Rafah, the United States has become increasingly globally isolated**

While reluctant for months, the Canadian government has now come out strong for ceasefire, especially after Israel's barbaric assault on Rafah. Barron's [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/39f08c83-caa1-4bb5-9368-9bc28d15e621?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Canada is "horrified" by the deaths of civilians from an Israeli air strike on a camp housing displaced Palestinians in Rafah, Foreign Minister Melanie Joly said in a social media post on Monday, calling for an ceasefire. "The images coming out of Rafah are horrific and heartbreaking," Joly said in a separate statement in the House of Commons, adding: "The killing of innocent civilians is completely unacceptable. The level of human suffering is catastrophic. That is why we need an immediate ceasefire."
France and Germany have not only called for a ceasefire, but have publicly declared that Israel is violating international law and is committing war crimes. [Germany has additionally confirmed they will arrest Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/15e5e97c-0300-4150-9d04-8ef541649de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) under its ICC obligations should the Israeli Prime Minister set foot in Germany.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/15e5e97c-0300-4150-9d04-8ef541649de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Three more American allies--Ireland, Norway, and Spain--have called for ceasefire and affirmed Israel is committing war crimes, and as of May 28th, have joined more than two-thirds of UN members in [recognizing Palestine as a sovereign State](https://substack.com/redirect/23a8b202-485c-4fec-a61c-a41262845295?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
None of this bodes well for the United States and its international standing. It should be a red flag for President Biden to uphold his Red Line. Israel, meanwhile, is further validating the grave concerns of America's closest allies in Europe, by surround Rafah with its tanks.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ae8yhNKgH3okucTW_nXXjZ4Yut7b6cvlVX_0eCZLWbo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145083108)
3. **Israeli tanks are surrounding Rafah prepping for a ground invasion --what should President Biden do?**

CNN [reports eyewitness testimony](https://substack.com/redirect/49f91ecd-36e7-486b-af80-0bbd3740d03e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Israeli tanks surrounding and entering Rafah, preparing for a ground invasion--one that will surely lead to countless more Palestinian civilian deaths:
> Israel's tanks were seen in central Rafah on Tuesday for the first time since its military entered Gaza's southernmost city earlier this month, two eyewitnesses told CNN, signaling a new phase in its offensive despite mounting global pressure. They arrive two days after a strike on a Rafah camp [killed dozens of displaced Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/955b29fc-0a57-48e8-9d7f-15553cc1d610?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday and as the international community urges Israel to stop its assault on the city.
So what should President Biden do? President Biden has an opportunity to uphold his Red Line and uphold the [ICJ ruling that ordered Israel to not invade Rafah](https://substack.com/redirect/f34ecda7-3b69-49df-be10-a83bbfb25d72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Doing so gives him a legitimate off ramp to say he misjudged the situation and is willing to right his wrongs. He can save face, hold Israel accountable, and most importantly, stop the preventable massacre of countless more Palestinians. Because in addition to all the aforementioned horrors, Palestinians are in Gaza are continuing to suffer famine as aid is not reaching them.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ae8yhNKgH3okucTW_nXXjZ4Yut7b6cvlVX_0eCZLWbo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145083108)
4. **Palestinians are still starving to death, and the pier the US Army built has been an abject failure**

Due to Israel's blockade on aid to Palestine (which is a war crime and violates the ICJ ruling last February), the United States committed to building a pier to transport aid to starving Gazans. That pier, [built by the US military to deliver aid to Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/4955763d-3d38-499e-ae68-31047e8749f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), broke apart and has been an abject failure. To recap, the US government wasted $320M in taxpayer building this pier. Of the 569 metric tons of aid that made it through the pier, the DOD reports that zero of it reached Gaza. And as the United States and local NGOs confirm, it is not Hamas who is blocking the aid. Instead, [multiple sources report that extremist Israeli settlers are blocking the aid](https://substack.com/redirect/683ea501-c18f-453d-8e4b-bdacdc9ab332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), after being tipped off by the Israeli military itself.
> Those blocking the vehicles say the aid they carry is being diverted by Hamas instead of being delivered to civilians in need, a claim relief agencies reject. US officials have also said that Israel has offered no evidence to support allegations that Hamas is diverting aid.Meanwhile, the United States is meting out zero consequences for the extremist settlers blocking the aid, zero consequences for Israeli Army for tipping off extremist settlers to block the aid, and is enacting zero change in US policy as Israel starves and kills Palestinians.
And still, President Biden refuses to enforce his Red Line.
**In Conclusion ...**
Whatever President Biden claims is his Red Line, no one has been able to point to where it actually is. Israel has starved Palestinians in Rafah, bombed them repeatedly, killed dozens upon dozens, and blocked all aid, leading to famine, and is now prepping a tank led ground invasion of Rafah. Rather than continue to trust an Israeli government that has repeatedly proven itself untrustworthy, the President should uphold his own word and international human rights law, and stop sending military aid to Israel to use on Palestinian civilians. Otherwise, the only Red Line left in Rafah, will be one drawn with the blood of innocent Palestinians.
I encourage every person reading this to contact the [White House](https://substack.com/redirect/fc5eb2bc-75cf-4b82-bd68-ea79ad400531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and your [US Senator](https://substack.com/redirect/c391d06b-b6de-4943-9d5d-407192e93293?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and demand an immediate ceasefire, unconditional release of all hostages, and accountability for the Israeli Government on the tenets of justice.

# [Demand protection for Trump jury members](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5869f4c6-4460-43d9-9557-23c687777019/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Members of the Trump jury in his NY trial have begun their deliberations to decide whether he is guilty or not. **And we need to demand they have adequate protection to ensure they can do this right, without putting themselves in danger.[Please join with us in demanding this NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbcbf4ddf-1b0c-412d-a589-fdd31dae82cd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Jury members are already getting veiled (and not so veiled) threats from MAGA extremists and even Trump himself. Jury pool members were dismissed earlier because they felt the danger would impact their ability to render a fair verdict. They'd seen what Trump followers did at the Capitol, and many other places across America. **These jury members need protection -- not just for the duration of the trial, but for an extended period thereafter** , when the threat will still be very real. If they are going to put themselves on the line, we need to be there for them. [**Please add your name, and demand protection for Trump jury members.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1dba46dc-fdf2-4b4c-ab9f-bfb47344fe8e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: a very difficult decision

body:
One of the many things that separates Ilhan from our opponents in this race is that she knows our movement always has her back when it matters most.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1165%2E791427%2EHCfD6j)
Hey folks, it's Makenzie. Ilhan's finance director.
I'm reaching out because over the holiday weekend, I made a difficult decision that I felt you deserved to know about.
As we get closer and closer to primary day, it's become clear that in order to continue organizing our progressive coalition in Minnesota's 5th district — and to make sure we have the financial resources to do so — we needed to _significantly_ scale up our organizing and advertising budgets.
Now, as you know, running a campaign isn't cheap. Especially when facing off against billionaires like Harlan Crow and right-wing dark money groups like AIPAC the way Ilhan is.
**Long story short: The money wasn't in our budget for May — but I gave the green light anyway.**
It was a risk. There's no doubt about that. But this is just one of many increasingly difficult decisions we'll have to make in the months ahead if we're going to win.
That's why I made a bet that if I asked, this movement would come together and help us fill the gap. And I'm really hoping you will — today. Not just for me, or for Ilhan, but for everyone across the country who cares about our movement's fight for justice in Congress and beyond.
**[So please: Can you make your first contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to stand with Ilhan and our campaign today? Every donation ahead of this week's end-of-month deadline will help us catch up while we make critical investments in this campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240529-1-subs&t=2&akid=1165%2E791427%2EHCfD6j)**
Like I said, this was a difficult decision, and please know that because of the way we're funding this campaign it wasn't one I made lightly.
But one of the many things that separates Ilhan from our opponents in this race is that she knows our movement always has her back when it matters most.
Thank you for chipping in today if you can.
In solidarity,
Makenzie Richardson
Finance Director

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1476%2E135344%2E2uH-J6)

Friend --
Yesterday, we launched our first ads of the campaign. But the decision to do so, at this moment, was a difficult one.
The reality is, launching this early, at the end of May -- just over 5 months until the election -- is a bit of a leap of faith.
On the one hand, we want to go up as soon as possible with so many undecided voters out there and Republicans starting to put out TV ads to rally voters.
On the other hand, the last thing a campaign wants to do is go up on television and come down while our potential opponents and their super PACs are on the air. There’s all kinds of data that makes clear that hurts the effectiveness of the ads.
And of course, because the vast majority of contributions will come only in the final weeks of the election -- September and October -- we don't have the money in the bank right now to stay up on the air between now and the time the first votes are cast.
So the bet we made, not without fiscal risk, was that supporters like you would understand the strategic choice we made, why it gives us the best chance to win, and contribute to help us fill the budget holes we have to fill in order to keep us on the air.
I hope you will. For our campaign. For control of the Senate. To win in Michigan this fall.

subject: Critical Message from Donald J. Trump
body:
| | | | critical message from Donald J Trump | [](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,

I am proud to share a critical message from President Donald J. Trump:

**_"Gerald Malloy is a REAL American Patriot who will work hard to stop crime, reduce inflation, and secure the border."_**

**[Today, I am reaching out to ask for your immediate support in a critical campaign—to defeat Bernie Sanders and counter the rise of socialism in America](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)**.

You might wonder, given Bernie Sanders' long tenure in Congress, why I believe we can defeat him now. My response is straightforward and twofold:

Bernie Sanders labels himself an "Independent," a euphemism perhaps too moderate for someone whose policies align closely with those far left of mainstream America. His extreme positions have even alienated many within the Democratic Party.

Vermont’s recent electoral outcomes are telling. The state overwhelmingly reelected their Republican Governor with 71% of the vote, a clear signal that Vermonters themselves are rejecting radical leftist policies.

[](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)
As a proud West Point graduate and a veteran with 22 years of distinguished service in the U.S. Army, I have always been committed to clear, direct communication. Let me be clear: 2024 represents our best opportunity to ensure America remains a land of freedom, not a socialist state.

I am Gerald Malloy, a combat veteran who served across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, earning a Bronze Star and 7 Meritorious Service Medals. My military career taught me about the sacrifices necessary to protect our Constitution—a sacred oath that, I believe, Bernie Sanders and his progressive allies do not uphold.

The radical progressive agenda, endorsed by Sanders and his cohort, threatens the very fabric of our nation. They have excused international terrorism, glorified criminals, and fostered chaos at our borders. Under their influence, we’ve seen an increase in political violence, a decline in national unity, and a distortion of what it means to be an American. This is not the America we cherish. It’s not the America for which I fought.

**_[Today, I am asking you to take a stand with me. Included with this email is your DEFEAT BERNIE SANDERS petition. I urge you to complete it with a generous donation and return it within the next 72 hours. Your prompt response is vital as we mobilize our campaign to protect the values that make our country great](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)_**.

We are at a historical crossroads. The upcoming election is not just a political contest; it is a battle to preserve the soul of our nation. Your support will enable us to combat the misguided socialist agenda and promote a strong, prosperous, and free America.

[](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)
**_[Please join me in this fight. Your contribution of $35 or more is not just a donation; it's a statement that you stand for freedom, for America, and against the tide of socialism](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)_**.

Thank you for considering this urgent appeal. Together, we can keep America true to its ideals and secure a future that honors our shared values of liberty and justice.

Warm regards,

Gerald Malloy

Republican for U.S. Senate

P.S.**[Your immediate action is crucial. We have a short window to make a significant impact. Please sign your DEFEAT BERNIE SANDERS petition today with a donation of $35 or more. Let’s show that America will never embrace socialism](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055).
**
P.P.S. Remember, 2024 is our year to demonstrate that the spirit of America will always prevail over the socialist agenda. Join me now in this vital mission—there's no time to lose. [](https://tk.deploymalloy.com/ga/click/2-636846-3-60-122-122-c4d2d205e8-8h4dd27055)
