body:
Peter, When Donald Trump was in Minnesota raising heaps of money for the state Republican Party this month, he repeated an outrageous lie that he “won” Minnesota in 2020, even though he lost by more than 200,000 votes.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85830464/476015635/-119038971?refcode=header&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2Q5MTlkYS1jNTFkLWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Bgf84GLU7oTjyIantfqZRcULI2QID2y_xpKfityhTI=)

Peter,
When Donald Trump was in Minnesota raising heaps of money for the state Republican Party this month, he repeated an outrageous lie that he “won” Minnesota in 2020, even though he lost by more than 200,000 votes.
Peter, this isn’t just a weird thing to say. It’s an affront to our democracy.
We cannot be complacent about the threat that Donald Trump poses to the future of our state and the entire country. Every poll this year shows Trump is already statistically tied with President Biden in Minnesota, and the attack ads haven’t even started running yet.
The reality is we have an extremely tough fight ahead of us over the next five months. As Chair of the Democratic Governors Association, I’m doing everything I can to sound the alarm and rally Democrats to the polls in Minnesota and across the country. Hi Peter, Team Wilson here with a weekly update as May is about to come to a close! Being one of Eric's strongest supporters, we wanted to make sure you know what we've been up to, and what we're planning. Eric's been all over WI-03, meeting voters where they are. If you haven't gotten a chance to meet him yet - don't worry - there are plenty of opportunities coming up soon! _**CAMPAIGN NEWS**_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85832150/476018741/-652460600?ms=240529_wi_newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTc2ZmMyZjQtYzYxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OsABk_T2rI-bTrTNqszZlowZJJMiN-kf2h30QVR00RM=&emci=b42b9433-a91d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=a76fc2f4-c61d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22611996) Over the weekend Eric and others from the Wilson team were able to attend the Memorial Weekend Pow Wow with the Ho Chunk Nation. We believe that protecting tribal sovereignty and ensuring access to lands for hunting, fishing, and conducting ceremonial rituals without interference is non-negotiable. Access to healthcare remains a significant challenge for many Indigenous and Native American communities. It is imperative that we advocate for increased funding for the Indian Health Service (IHS) to ensure that everyone has access to quality healthcare. Let us continue to stand together, fight for your rights, and work towards a brighter, more equitable future for all our communities. Thank you to the Ho Chunk Nation for your warm hospitality. Thank you - Pinigigi. _**WHERE IS WILSON?**_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85832151/476018742/-652460600?ms=240529_wi_newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTc2ZmMyZjQtYzYxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OsABk_T2rI-bTrTNqszZlowZJJMiN-kf2h30QVR00RM=&emci=b42b9433-a91d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=a76fc2f4-c61d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22611996)** Summer is starting and so are outdoor events! Be on the lookout...when it comes to District 3, Eric is here, there, and everywhere! _**IN THE NEWS**_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85832152/476018743/-1160908916?ms=240529_wi_newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTc2ZmMyZjQtYzYxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OsABk_T2rI-bTrTNqszZlowZJJMiN-kf2h30QVR00RM=&emci=b42b9433-a91d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=a76fc2f4-c61d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22611996) Democrat and Republican officials are ramping up efforts to enlist members of their party to work as poll workers. body:
If either Tammy Baldwin or Elissa Slotkin lose their Senate races, Republicans will have control of the Senate. Period.

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to split a donation between Tammy Baldwin and Elissa Slotkin's campaigns for U.S. Senate. Please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.
Here is the truth:
If either Tammy Baldwin or Elissa Slotkin lose their Senate races, Republicans will have control of the Senate. Period.
And if Trump wins the White House, control of the Senate could be the only thing holding him back from total control. Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it is the truth.
Now, both Tammy and Elissa made the difficult decision to launch their first television ads recently.
It was a risk for both of them, because you never want to launch ads and have to take them down before the election. Campaigns that do that will often lose.
But both of their opponents were running ads, and they had to get on the air or risk falling behind. And the bet they made was that people who understand the stakes of their races would fill their budget gaps created by the decision to spend early.
They've both asked if we can help before their May fundraising deadline ends Friday at midnight.
The average donation to these requests is around $30. Some donate more, others give less. All that matters is that we are helping these two women win their Senate races this fall. So with that said:

| | | | | **New Poll Confirms Virginia Is In Play** **ICYMI:** Governor Glenn Youngkin made it clear last week: Virginia is in play this year.

Youngkin, speaking to Laura Ingraham, highlighted the commonsense conservative leadership that is delivering for Virginians with lower taxes, more jobs, and a strong economy and argued that Virginians want more of that leadership at the national level.

| "I think Virginia is in play. Here's why: In 2021, Virginians made a decision for commonsense conservative leadership. We, in fact, have proven that it works; Virginians like it, and they see the economy that Donald Trump built in his previous presidency, and they see the one we built in Virginia; they want more of it, they want leadership, and that's why I think Virginia is in play this year," said Governor Youngkin.

That argument is backed up by _[new polling released by Roanoke College](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=3780ff092d9d00c6b44445b67a12cab72b7cdbc2430ee0d23491d0dc2aaaccf5654f709645ac800364a92d1ef1e540e65c674c965668c5d84bcf5cc229b69a51 "new polling released by Roanoke College")_ , which showed Donald Trump and Joe Biden tied in Virginia ahead of the 2024 elections after Joe Biden won Virginia by 10 points in 2020.

The same poll showed Biden with a 61% disapproval rating among Virginians. Meanwhile, Governor Youngkin's strong job approval rating has remained steady at 52% in the Roanoke poll and he enjoys a net favorability rating of 9 points.

Governor Youngkin's common sense conservative leadership is making Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family and Virginians want more of it.

Friends,
The impact of these hospital closures is deeply felt in our communities. When our leaders prioritize for-profit healthcare, private insurers fail to pay, rural facilities don't make money, shut down, and leave.
In the past year, we've witnessed the closure of two vital facilities in Northern Michigan and the UP, or hospitals reporting losses and not fairly compensating nurses - which could cause a mass-exodus of healthcare workers.
A single-payer system that fully covers care for every patient would be a game-changer.
It's time to end the havoc wreaked by private insurance and Medicare Advantage plans (not Medicare), which undermine our medical care system.
We need a publicly financed, non-profit national health insurance program that fully covers medical care for every American citizen, and we need it now.
With adequate pay, it will help rural clinics survive.
To continue our mission advocating for universal care, I want to take our voices to US Congress. To get there, to continue to fight for your freedoms, families, and futures, my campaign relies solely on grassroots contributions from the generosity of donors like you.

This crisis demands immediate action. drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob] [] I am the only candidate in the race advocating for a single-payer system that will solve the problem. With just a few days left to reach our end-of-the-month fundraising goal, I urge you to stand with me and help me be the 'Doctor in the House' who leads healthcare reform. CONTRIBUTE [drbob.me/aboutbob] Friends, The impact of these hospital closures is deeply felt in our communities. When our leaders prioritize for-profit healthcare, private insurers fail to pay, rural facilities don't make money, shut down, and leave. In the past year, we've witnessed the closure of two vital facilities in Northern Michigan and the UP, or hospitals reporting losses and not fairly compensating nurses - which could cause a mass-exodus of healthcare workers. A single-payer system that fully covers care for every patient would be a game-changer. It's time to end the havoc wreaked by private insurance and Medicare Advantage plans (not Medicare), which undermine our medical care system. We need a publicly financed, non-profit national health insurance program that fully covers medical care for every American citizen, and we need it now. With adequate pay, it will help rural clinics survive. To continue our mission advocating for universal care, I want to take our voices to US Congress. To get there, to continue to fight for your freedoms, families, and futures, my campaign relies solely on grassroots contributions from the generosity of donors like you. Thank you. -Dr. Bob Bob Lorinser, MD, MSW, MPH Candidate for US Congress Northern Michigan, Upper Peninsula Democrat, MI01 CONTRIBUTE [drbob.me/aboutbob] [] Or, send a check to Friends of Dr. Bob PO Box 936 Marquette, MI 49855 United States PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF DR. Rick Scott knows that he can't win this race by telling the truth about his record. He built his fortune as the CEO of a hospital chain convicted of what the Justice Department called the largest Medicare fraud scheme ever at the time. He made off with millions, pled the Fifth, and faced no consequences. Now, he's pushing a far-right agenda that would ban abortions, raise taxes on working families, and end Social Security and Medicare.
My story is different. As a teen immigrant from Ecuador, I fought hard to create my own American dream. In high school, I worked early morning shifts to help my family afford rent for our one room apartment.
I studied hard to earn a scholarship that made college possible for me and dedicated my career to public service. Eventually, I ran for Congress, flipped a battleground district blue, and became the first South American immigrant elected to the House. In Congress, I fought tirelessly to expand Medicare access, lower the cost of living, end gun violence, and protect families like yours.
**I've spent my life giving back to the communities that gave me so much and fighting to protect the opportunities that made my story possible. Rick Scott has spent his career getting rich and leaving working families behind. That's why I'm running for Senate to defeat him — because Floridians will suffer if he wins six more years.**

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Scott Presler Visits Chicago, Energizes Black, Hispanic Residents and Inmates to Register to Vote Early and Elect Donald Trump (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/scott-presler-visits-chicago-energizes-black-hispanic-residents-and-inmates-to-register-vote-early-and-elect-donald-trump.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/scott-presler-visits-chicago-energizes-black-hispanic-residents-and-inmates-to-register-vote-early-and-elect-donald-trump.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Scott Presler meets with inmates at the DuPage County, Ill. jail with Sheriff James Mendrick on May 24, 2024. (Video caption credit: Christian Sass/@seventalentscom)

By Illinois Review
Conservative activist and Early Vote Action (https://earlyvoteaction.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) founder Scott Presler, who gained notoriety in 2019 when he organized over 200 volunteers to remove over 12 tons of trash from the City of Baltimore, was in Chicago to mobilize Black and Hispanic residents – constituencies abandoned by the Democratic Party, and register them to vote and vote early and make Joe Biden a one-term president.

The conservative social media influencer, who has amassed over 1.5 million followers on X, hit the ground running – wasting no time during his brief visit. On Wednesday evening, Presler visited The Three Headed Eagle Alliance (https://www.threeheadedeaglealliance.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in Geneva – a suburb west of downtown Chicago, where he addressed hundreds of conservative grassroots activists on the importance of registering voters and voting early.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/scott-presler-visits-chicago-energizes-black-hispanic-residents-and-inmates-to-register-vote-early-and-elect-donald-trump.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ec1897f868-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Presler also met with DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick and toured the county jail. Mendrick places an emphasis on “rehabilitation” at his jail – where there are virtual welding classes, a garden that supplies produce for local food pantries, vocational training and education courses and a “Redemption Studio” that covers gang tattoos for inmates wanting to turn their life around. Presler also met with inmates and discussed his voter registration efforts, saying,

“When you guys are integrated back into society, I want to make sure that you become a part of the community and that you vote – and that you make sure you’re trying to impact your communities for the better. That’s my goal.”

On Wednesday evening, Presler visited The Three Headed Eagle Alliance () in Geneva – a suburb west of downtown Chicago, where he addressed hundreds of conservative grassroots activists on the importance of registering voters and voting early. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Presler also met with DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick and toured the county jail. Mendrick places an emphasis on “rehabilitation” at his jail – where there are virtual welding classes, a garden that supplies produce for local food pantries, vocational training and education courses and a “Redemption Studio” that covers gang tattoos for inmates wanting to turn their life around. Presler also met with inmates and discussed his voter registration efforts, saying, “When you guys are integrated back into society, I want to make sure that you become a part of the community and that you vote – and that you make sure you’re trying to impact your communities for the better. That’s my goal.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Copyright © 2023 IR Media Corp., all rights reserved. | | | **PRESS RELEASE**

**Seattle liberal Marty O’Donnell loans his fading campaign nearly $1M two weeks before Election Day**

_Despite his dwindling poll numbers, and inability to resonate with the grassroots, O’Donnell is trying to buy this critical congressional seat._ April 29, 2024 Contact: [info@drewfornevada.com](mailto:press@drewfornevada.com) (**Las Vegas, NV**) – Over Memorial Day weekend, Nevada 3rd district congressional candidate Marty O'Donnell loaned his campaign $700,000 in a brazen attempt to buy this crucial U.S. House seat. O'Donnell's campaign has failed to gain traction since announcing his candidacy in March. The liberal musician has been [marred by social media posts](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=4eb5420a84&e=fc26432468) in which he called President Donald Trump an "idiot," compared Trump's supporters to Nazis and farm animals, campaigned for socialist Bernie Sanders, and even celebrated President Obama's tax hikes. O'Donnell claims serving[ on jury duty](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=09e1a7b6cd&e=fc26432468) as his previous political experience. Las Vegas-based [Liberty Watch magazine](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ac20818b4f&e=fc26432468) called O'Donnell "one of most unqualified, ill-prepared candidates to run for office in Nevada in recent memory." Now, in a desperate, last-ditch effort to buy the primary, he has loaned his campaign $700,000, much of which will presumably be used to attack conservative Republican front-runner and grassroots favorite Drew Johnson. During a May interview with [_The Epoch Times_](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=6b51f5582a&e=fc26432468), O'Donnell admitted this troubling scheme, stating, _"I'm not going to lose because someone thinks they can spend more money than me, because they can't."_ When asked about O'Donnell's antics, Johnson stated: _"It's no surprise that Never Trumper Marty O'Donnell's campaign has hit a sour note with voters. He can't hide from his very public record of supporting and promoting far-left candidates and causes. _ _O'Donnell refuses to debate because he doesn’t understand the issues facing our district, he has made no effort to meet the voters of the district and hear their concerns, and he has never even sat foot in significant areas of CD3 like Laughlin, Searchlight, Sandy Valley, Little Ethiopia, the_ ___Dean Martin RNP,_ _or Section 10._ _His only chance to win this election is to try to buy it because he sure doesn't deserve to serve in Congress based on merit or commitment to the people of the 3rd district._ _Southern Nevada voters are too smart to allow some guy who just moved to town from Seattle to buy this Congressional seat. Our campaign has been on the ground, working hard to win this primary for more than a year. According to the poll numbers, our message and enthusiasm have resonated well with the voters."_ The primary for Nevada's 3rd congressional district will be held on June 11th. Early voting is underway. To learn more about Drew and his campaign, please visit [DrewforNevada.com](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=5c7e991ab9&e=fc26432468).
_###_

I know you see it in the media, fathers are often portrayed as disengaged, emotionally distant, or even absent altogether. Sadly, people have nowhere to look to see examples of good, Godly dads. But what if I told you there's a **better way**? A path that leads to _gracious, gospel-centered fathers_ who can display to their families a glimpse of the love of our Heavenly Father? This Father's Day, I want to help you rediscover the power of biblical fatherhood -- and 1517 has a _great resource_ to guide you on that journey. That resource is _Being Dad_ \- a book I wrote that delves deep into the heart of what it means to be a father, grounded in the timeless wisdom of Scripture. [**As we approach Father's Day, we want to provide this valuable resource to as many fathers as possible, which is why, when you support 1517 with a gift of any amount today, we will send you a FREE copy of _Being Dad_ as a token of our thanks for your partnership**** _._**](http://trk.secureandprosper._sQ)

This truth has the power to produce gracious, Christ-centered fathers who can display a powerful picture of the love of their Heavenly Father, drawing their children into the embrace of saving faith. **[When you support 1517 with a gift of any amount this Father's Day, we will send you a FREE copy of _Being Dad_ as our thanks for your partnership _._](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

But what if I told you there's a better way? A path that leads to gracious, gospel-centered fathers who can display to their families a glimpse of the love of our Heavenly Father? This Father's Day, I want to help you rediscover the power of biblical fatherhood -- and 1517 has a great resource to guide you on that journey. That resource is Being Dad \- a book I wrote that delves deep into the heart of what it means to be a father, grounded in the timeless wisdom of Scripture. In Being Dad , I bring my failures and successes as a family man and my Biblical scholarship to bear on the difficult task of fatherhood, offering a fresh and insightful perspective. Unlike other books on fatherhood, Being Dad recognizes the struggles of fatherhood and offers the one thing that can sustain dads -- the forgiveness and love of our Heavenly Father. Being Dad reminds all of us that forgiven fathers are a gift from God , for they have been given the gospel and are empowered by the Holy Spirit to proclaim it to their families. This truth has the power to produce gracious, Christ-centered fathers who can display a powerful picture of the love of their Heavenly Father, drawing their children into the embrace of saving faith. 1517 understands that the challenges facing fathers today are immense. But this book's message is one of hope, redemption, and the transformative power of the Gospel. This Father 's Day, I urge you to seize the opportunity to invest in the lives of fathers and families in your community. clean_body: ONE CITIZEN. ONE VOTE. Friend, I introduced the SAVE ACT - which will protect American voters and prevent illegal aliens from voting in federal elections. But across the country -- illegal immigrants are being registered to vote. ONE CITIZEN. ONE VOTE. That's the way it's been and that's what federal law requires. The SAVE ACT would stop this and it should pass unanimously -- by both Republicans AND Democrats who believe in democracy and FAIR ELECTIONS. In fact, the only reason to oppose this that I can think of is if you're comfortable with or want non-citizens to vote. Or want non-citizens to influence the outcome of our elections. There are estimates putting non-citizens in this country somewhere approaching 30 MILLION. This is a major threat to our democracy and the SAVE ACT is our last chance to protect our elections. ****************************************************************************************************** I'm fighting for YOU, I'm fighting for our Democracy, and I'm fighting to prevent non-citizens from dictating our elections. This should have unanimous support. But I'm sure we'll face opposition. Chip in just $1 and stand with me today: Thanks, Senator Mike Lee ****************************************************************************************************** | Paid for by the NRSC. | | | Larry Hogan and I disagree on a lot of things, and here are 3 areas where we differ: _I believe abortion should be safe, legal, and accessible for everyone, but Hogan disagrees_. **During his time as governor, he vetoed legislation to expand abortion access, and you’d better believe he’d pave the way for national Republicans to pass a national abortion ban. name: Team AOC
subject: Families in Rafah are in urgent need of humanitarian support.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians are sheltering in Rafah. On Sunday night, an IDF airstrike on Rafah killed 45 Palestinians and injured dozens more.1
Families in the area are in urgent need of humanitarian support.
**Today, we’re asking you to support frontline organizations that are working around the clock to save lives in Rafah.**
_100% of your donation goes directly to relief efforts on the ground._
**World Central Kitchen (WCK)** has been on the ground since October, providing food for Palestinian families in many ways, from serving hot meals to providing ready-to-eat meal kits to empowering people who can cook for themselves. Ongoing attacks have forced them to close their main kitchen in Rafah, but their commitment continues. WCK’s network of community kitchens across Gaza, as well as their main kitchens in Deir al-Balah and Al-Mawasi, is led by Palestinian teams that are cooking tens of thousands of meals daily. WCK is also dispatching aid trucks into Gaza to increase their capacity to support displaced families.
**[Donate $5 to World Central Kitchen →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28546?refcode=em20240529-6508-P_FND_CHA_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6508%2E2526796%2ED0trz2)**
**Palestine Children’s Relief Fund** is focused on immediate emergency response, and thanks to overwhelming global support has been providing essential medical supplies, food, medical treatment, clean water, and other necessities for Palestinian families directly affected by this unprecedented humanitarian crisis. They just completed construction on a field hospital in Rafah with 100 beds, a pediatric clinic, and a desalination facility to ensure a study supply of clean water.
**[Donate $5 to Palestine Children’s Relief Fund →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28509?t=2&akid=6508%2E2526796%2ED0trz2)**
Whether or not you can donate today, thank you for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
1 - [**NPR** : An Israeli airstrike killed 45 Palestinians in an encampment for displaced people](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28545?t=3&akid=6508%2E2526796%2ED0trz2)

I’m the child of immigrants, the first generation. This country gave me everything, and I felt like I needed to give back. I swore to defend our Constitution, our democracy, from all enemies — foreign and domestic.
But when I signed up, I never thought this was how things would end up.
Over the last several years the most insidious threats to our Constitution have emerged at home. It’s people like Donald Trump and his “MAGA Queen” Kari Lake — openly advocating for violence and repression, tearing down our elections, laying the groundwork for dictatorship and authoritarian rule.
If they win, it could mean the end of our Republic. I’m sorry to say this, but it can happen here. We can stop them, but it’s going to take a ton of hard work. And Arizona will be the frontline in the fight for our democracy.

If a candidate doesn’t have the resources to talk to voters, persuade them, and turn them out to the polls, it can be nearly impossible to secure a victory once the other side starts spending money.
And the other side will start spending money – that much Democrats can always count on.

Talks Border, Energy, and More with Power the Future's Rick Whitbeck

ANCHORAGE, AK - Last night, Alaska Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom joined
Power the Future's Rick Whitbeck on the Alaska Energy Hour
<https://soundcloud.com/user-988952581/alaska-energy-hour-guests-wtp-aks
-ken-h-congressional-candidate-nancy-dahlstrom-052824?utm_source=x.com&u
tm_campaign=wtshare&utm_medium=widget&utm_content=https%253A%252F%252Fso
undcloud.com%252Fuser-988952581%252Falaska-energy-hour-guests-wtp-aks-ke
n-h-congressional-candidate-nancy-dahlstrom-052824> to talk about her
recent trip to the southern border, Alaska's energy potential, and more.

In the interview, Lt. Governor Dahlstrom highlighted her experiences
while taking a night tour of the southern border, including watching as
migrants walked along the Mexico side of President Trump's border wall
toward an opening left by Joe Biden and Mary Peltola. Dahlstrom also
recounted seeing illegal immigrants who had crossed, flipping the bird
to Border Patrol agents after the migrants successfully broke our
nation's laws.

"The more people know about the border situation, the madder they get,
and the more they stand up and we demand what needs to happen," said
Dahlstrom.

"I left there pretty disheartened in many ways about what I saw, but on
the other hand, really charged up. We have to be more vocal, we have to
be more active," said Dahlstrom. "And people have to get involved in
making changes with our government, because what's happening in D.C.
right now is unacceptable."

Dahlstrom also touched on Joe Biden's short-sighted decision to release
1 million more barrels of oil from our strategic petroleum reserves.
Joe Biden's decision, enabled by Democrats in Congress like Mary
Peltola, puts the United States's national security at risk in the
event of an attack, natural disaster, or worse.

"I about died last week when I heard that Biden was releasing another
million barrels of gas from the reserves because he wants to lower gas
prices.That is such a bad idea. It's horrible. We know it's going to
increase inflation overall, plus, even more important, it's trading a
vital resource that we might need in times of emergency or national
crisis."

Peter,

Over the holiday weekend, while many Americans were distracted and after
the International Court of Justice instructed Israel to cease all military
operations in Rafah, Israel launched more than 60 strikes on the refugee
city, including dropping multiple 2,000-pound bombs on a “safe zone” of
displaced civilians living in tents.

This was an utterly horrific massacre, with people burned alive as well as
infants and children decapitated. At least 45 Palestinians were killed,
with more injured. It should have never happened, and we cannot let it
happen again.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240529_rafah/?source=em20240529-35032&akid=35032%2E1203867%2EVjS_rj ]Sign our petition right now demanding the Biden Administration
immediately halt ALL weapons transfers to Israel →

Hamas leaders had a base near the humanitarian site, Netanyahu made a
statement saying this bombardment was a “mistake.” Regardless, Israel
intentionally bombed refugees living in tents – it was an unjustifiable,
heinous war crime, and Israel MUST be held accountable.

President Biden repeatedly said that attacking Rafah was a red line.
Israel has since attacked this humanitarian zone numerous times, with
tanks now in the city center — but as of yesterday, the White House says
Netanyahu still hasn’t crossed the red line.

The line has been crossed, time and time again. We cannot let our

bombs, and weapons to Israel to enable their genocide against

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

|
---
Friend,
If you follow my work, you know I’ve conducted hundreds of focus groups with voters of all backgrounds. One demographic I’ve been focused on is “flippers”—people who voted for Trump in 2016 but not 2020.
They’re the key reason Trump lost four years ago, and it’s more important than ever to know how they’re thinking about this race. The bad news is that many are considering returning to Trump.
**The reason is simple: They’ve forgotten what they hate about Trump.**
I call this phenomenon “Trump amnesia.” These folks have started to filter out his insanity and the chaos and division he would sow in our politics. That's why it's on us to remind them of these things and show them how much worse a second Trump term would be.
[That’s where you come in](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VXgDqD2DBZYxW4n1rJ57WBNgRW6y9Q695fHHlkN13dgpM3m2ndW6N1vHY6lZ3ppW47xytG5kTdYqW3vtBXS7r3Q0WW8SbWV_1b19hZVbhGMc7Mghl1W1fsDhd4qWv4FVCyL114RhXP1N3RZrYzQt41xW5lr2k-81jZQqW1y9Cq-8P64yNW3fQ_Hp32VgGxW3XMclD89PV85W7Hl4kK4XH5XqN5DC-GnbcgwCW7KFFc078dWbRVbpZy42tBYTKW2S9gsR2bBd8QVQSng98dV56-W379dsY5Y9Z5xW5R4Tvv2JNJ_XN1nw0H1JY8lwW8fQZr93dKLxqW8H_G4P8vMbYwf47p3Jz04). Can you chip in to help us remind these voters what they hate about Trump? His constant lies, his corruption, his attacks on our allies, his contempt for our military, his anti-constitutional stances, his disastrous COVID response, and the countless other crises—we need to make sure all of this is front-of-mind for voters. And we need to do it **now**.

They’re a key reason Trump lost four years ago. | Friend, If you follow my work, you know I’ve conducted hundreds of focus groups with voters of all backgrounds. One demographic I’ve been focused on is “flippers”—people who voted for Trump in 2016 but not 2020. They’re the key reason Trump lost four years ago, and it’s more important than ever to know how they’re thinking about this race. The bad news is that many are considering returning to Trump. The reason is simple: They’ve forgotten what they hate about Trump. I call this phenomenon “Trump amnesia.” These folks have started to filter out his insanity and the chaos and division he would sow in our politics. That's why it's on us to remind them of these things and show them how much worse a second Trump term would be. . Can you chip in to help us remind these voters what they hate about Trump? His constant lies, his corruption, his attacks on our allies, his contempt for our military, his anti-constitutional stances, his disastrous COVID response, and the countless other crises—we need to make sure all of this is front-of-mind for voters. And we need to do it now. | I hope you can help us out. . Thank you for your unwavering support. Friend,
**With the GOP prepared to invest millions of dollars into flipping New York red, I’ve set an ambitious $125,000 end-of-month goal.**
I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a donation to help me meet this critical end-of-month goal. **[_(If you’re ready to give now, you can chip in here.)_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85855692/476085624/-862660935?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5080-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWYwNTc5Mi1lNDFkLWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cn8UloQAGWMhwCdfEYjjReNUG3G8ioFEBbYEanMVGeg=)**
But first, I want to personally thank you for standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns across the nation.
Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect **Social Security and Medicare** and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity.

Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to **certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights.
**But here's the bad news: If Republicans flip even one Senate seat, they could retake the majority and _undo all of our progress_. Peter, Yesterday we turned in signatures for ballot access in New York - a victory for grassroots democracy against political repression. Thank you to everyone who supported this Herculean effort!
---
---
The intense mobilization by volunteers across the state to collect the massive number of signatures demanded by New York State shows the powerful hunger for a real choice at the ballot box. We’re inspired by everyone who stood up in the current environment of repression and fear to fight for a better way forward for New York, the United States, and the world. **_Now we are waiting for the final review from the NYS Board of Elections - stay tuned for updates._** Our supporters answered the call to get tens of thousands of signatures in just a few weeks, in what we believe is the hardest place to get on the ballot in the so-called free world. Outrageously, after taking control of NY state government, the Democratic Party took advantage of the must-pass Covid relief budget bill to quietly triple the number of signatures we need to collect - right in the middle of a global pandemic, without public attention or discussion. This despicable maneuver shows that while the Democrats preach about ‘saving democracy’ they’ll stop at nothing to remove grassroots choices from your ballot. Their constant scheming to prevent their competitors from even running makes a mockery of democracy and amounts to the ruling elites using state power for political repression. The Democrats have already broadcast that they are employing every dirty tactic you can imagine to try to keep other choices off voters’ ballots. Given this oppressive political environment, ****_**we are making sure to keep legal options on the table to ensure that New York voters have the choice they deserve.**_ Through all this repression, our volunteers stepped up with a heroic effort to give New Yorkers a choice to vote **_for an end to endless war and genocide, an economy that works for working people, and a livable future for our children._** If you believe, like I do, that it is imperative that we continue to fight for ballot access across this country, despite the enormous lift in states like New York, so that every single voter in this country has an alternative to the parties of war and Wall Street, please pitch in today:

clean_body: Staying the course for an anti-genocide, pro-worker choice | | | Peter, Yesterday we turned in signatures for ballot access in New York - a victory for grassroots democracy against political repression. Thank you to everyone who supported this Herculean effort! The intense mobilization by volunteers across the state to collect the massive number of signatures demanded by New York State shows the powerful hunger for a real choice at the ballot box. We’re inspired by everyone who stood up in the current environment of repression and fear to fight for a better way forward for New York, the United States, and the world. Now we are waiting for the final review from the NYS Board of Elections - stay tuned for updates. Our supporters answered the call to get tens of thousands of signatures in just a few weeks, in what we believe is the hardest place to get on the ballot in the so-called free world. Outrageously, after taking control of NY state government, the Democratic Party took advantage of the must-pass Covid relief budget bill to quietly triple the number of signatures we need to collect - right in the middle of a global pandemic, without public attention or discussion. This despicable maneuver shows that while the Democrats preach about ‘saving democracy’ they’ll stop at nothing to remove grassroots choices from your ballot. Their constant scheming to prevent their competitors from even running makes a mockery of democracy and amounts to the ruling elites using state power for political repression. The Democrats have already broadcast that they are employing every dirty tactic you can imagine to try to keep other choices off voters’ ballots. Given this oppressive political environment, **we are making sure to keep legal options on the table to ensure that New York voters have the choice they deserve. Through all this repression, our volunteers stepped up with a heroic effort to give New Yorkers a choice to vote for an end to endless war and genocide, an economy that works for working people, and a livable future for our children. If you believe, like I do, that it is imperative that we continue to fight for ballot access across this country, despite the enormous lift in states like New York, so that every single voter in this country has an alternative to the parties of war and Wall Street, please pitch in today: | "CONTRIBUTE TODAY" I’m incredibly grateful to everyone who gathered signatures and donated to help us get ballot access in New York. And I am excited and hopeful for what comes next! body:
NRDC joins Sierra Club, League of Conservation Voters, & Center for Biological Diversity backing Min as the Clear Choice for Environmental Leadership | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bbe356e0d947/natural-resources-defense-council-endorses-dave-min-for-congress-16197316?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For Immediate Release:** May 29, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Natural Resources Defense Council Endorses Dave Min for Congress**
_NRDC joins Sierra Club, League of Conservation Voters, and Center for Biological Diversity backing Min as the Clear Choice for Environmental Leadership _
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC) endorsed Dave Min for Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District, joining a long list of major environmental groups such as the Sierra Club, California Environmental Voters, and the Center for Biological Diversity backing his campaign. State Senator Min, chair of the Natural Resources and Water Committee, has consistently demonstrated leadership on environmental issues, earning him broad support from the environmental community. The Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC) is a leading environmental advocacy group that combines grassroots action with legal expertise to safeguard the earth and its inhabitants. With over 3 million members and a team of nearly 700 professionals, the NRDC is at the forefront of efforts to address the climate crisis, preserve natural habitats, and promote environmental justice.

**“Climate change is the defining issue of our time,”** said Dave Min. **“We need leaders in Congress who will fight for the seismic and unilateral changes needed to prevent the worst effects of the climate crisis that we know are coming, and which have already begun. In California, I’ve been an outspoken and effective leader on decarbonization and biodiversity issues. As your congressman, I will advocate tirelessly for policies that ensure a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren.”**

Unlike his general election opponent Scott Baugh, who has consistently failed to prioritize environmental protection and has ties to special interests that profit from fossil fuel extraction, Dave has consistently put the interests of Orange County families and our planet first. While serving in the State Senate, Baugh voted against Assembly Bill 1280, which would have required that any new pumping operation off the California coast use pipelines rather than tankers to reduce the risk of a major spill. If passed, AB 1280 could have prevented a 2021 disaster where 25,000 pounds of crude oil leaked into the ocean off Huntington Beach when two tanker ship anchors hit an offshore pipeline. The bill was strongly opposed by the oil industry. With California facing increasingly severe impacts of climate change, including wildfires, droughts, and rising sea levels, the choice in this election is clear: Dave is the climate champion that CA-47 needs in Congress.

Min is not only the unanimous choice of environmental groups, he has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, California Governor Gavin Newsom, and over 50 local elected officials. He is also the consensus choice of Teachers, Police, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the Fraternal Order of Police, the Police Officers Research Association of California, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=aa7d99b55c&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. State Senator Min, chair of the Natural Resources and Water Committee, has consistently demonstrated leadership on environmental issues, earning him broad support from the environmental community. The Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC) is a leading environmental advocacy group that combines grassroots action with legal expertise to safeguard the earth and its inhabitants. With over 3 million members and a team of nearly 700 professionals, the NRDC is at the forefront of efforts to address the climate crisis, preserve natural habitats, and promote environmental justice. “Climate change is the defining issue of our time,” said Dave Min. “We need leaders in Congress who will fight for the seismic and unilateral changes needed to prevent the worst effects of the climate crisis that we know are coming, and which have already begun. In California, I’ve been an outspoken and effective leader on decarbonization and biodiversity issues. As your congressman, I will advocate tirelessly for policies that ensure a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren.” Unlike his general election opponent Scott Baugh, who has consistently failed to prioritize environmental protection and has ties to special interests that profit from fossil fuel extraction, Dave has consistently put the interests of Orange County families and our planet first. While serving in the State Senate, Baugh voted against Assembly Bill 1280, which would have required that any new pumping operation off the California coast use pipelines rather than tankers to reduce the risk of a major spill. If passed, AB 1280 could have prevented a 2021 disaster where 25,000 pounds of crude oil leaked into the ocean off Huntington Beach when two tanker ship anchors hit an offshore pipeline. The bill was strongly opposed by the oil industry. With California facing increasingly severe impacts of climate change, including wildfires, droughts, and rising sea levels, the choice in this election is clear: Dave is the climate champion that CA-47 needs in Congress. Min is not only the unanimous choice of environmental groups, he has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, California Governor Gavin Newsom, and over 50 local elected officials. He is also the consensus choice of Teachers, Police, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the Fraternal Order of Police, the Police Officers Research Association of California, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. Dear Friend of Liberty,

I wanted to bring to your attention a critical issue that affects us all.

Recently, Danielle Johnson bravely took a stand against DEI and discriminatory practices within her company, the Oregon Department of Environmental Quality.

However, when she merely questioned these racist DEI practices, she was called a racist in an all-company e-mail, had her pay cut, and was demoted.

DEI is thinly disguised racism. Danielle spoke up against it and now is fighting back by suing her employer.

This fight, however, isn't just about Danielle--it's about you, too. When her right to free speech is in danger, yours is also at risk. We cannot stand and watch as our fundamental rights are destroyed.

At Mountain States Legal Foundation, we are committed to supporting Danielle in her pursuit of justice. But we cannot do it without your help.

Dear Peter,
The June 18th primary election to nominate our Republican candidate for Congress here in Virginia’s 7th is fast approaching!
We wanted to reach out with a number of opportunities to meet Cameron Hamilton over the coming week, and learn about his campaign for Congress.
This **Thursday evening May 30th** , Cameron will be hosting a Meet & Greet in **Prince William County** at the Ashland Conservancy Club House (5550 Fincastle Dr, Manassas, VA) from 6pm-8pm. Food will be provided, and Cameron will speak on his campaign and answer any questions you have! Details here:
---
| —
This**Friday evening May 31st** , Cameron will be at WAR Craft Brewery (7851 White Oak Rd, Rapidan, VA) in **Culpeper County** from 6pm-8pm. We’ll have live music, food and drink from WAR Craft, a food truck, and the opportunity to meet Cameron and hear from him about his campaign! Details here:
---
| —
Lastly, we have an opportunity **Monday June 3rd** to meet and hear from Senator Rand Paul and Cameron Hamilton in **Fredericksburg**! Senator Paul is a champion of Liberty, and he’s supporting Cameron Hamilton because he knows Cameron will be a huge help in his efforts to defend the American People. The event will be held at Gourmeltz (10013 Patriot Hwy, Fredericksburg, VA). Doors open at 3pm, and the event will begin at 4pm. Arrive early for a good seat! Details here:
---
| We look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail!
Team Hamilton

name: Karen at United We Dream Action
subject: I watched ICE officers knock on my door to arrest me
body:
I watched as ICE officers knocked on our door to arrest my father and me, and forced ankle monitors onto my mother and sister. | | | Hi Peter, **** When I was 18 years old, I watched as ICE officers knocked on our door to arrest my father and me, and forced ankle monitors onto my mother and sister. This traumatic scene unfolded after years of legal battles and confusion ever since my family applied for political asylum. Our lawyer never told us our case would carry deportation orders for our entire family. This is the reality for so many young people in the United States, living in the shadows to escape deportations, afraid every day of being separated from their families. Luckily, DACA arrived soon after, and my world opened up. I was free to go to school and work, support my family and secure my future. DACA changed everything for me — and now it’s in greater danger than it has ever been before. DACA is likely on its way to the Supreme Court for the second time, and we can’t be certain what comes next. But the one thing I know for sure is my family and families like mine need more than temporary protections. We are contributing members of our society, and should not be treated as threats or targets. Enough is enough. **[That’s why United We Dream Action is not only preparing for the DACA fights ahead, but ALSO securing a pathway to citizenship for all 11 million undocumented people. This traumatic scene unfolded after years of legal battles and confusion ever since my family applied for political asylum. Our lawyer never told us our case would carry deportation orders for our entire family. This is the reality for so many young people in the United States, living in the shadows to escape deportations, afraid every day of being separated from their families. Luckily, DACA arrived soon after, and my world opened up. I was free to go to school and work, support my family and secure my future. DACA changed everything for me — and now it’s in greater danger than it has ever been before. DACA is likely on its way to the Supreme Court for the second time, and we can’t be certain what comes next. But the one thing I know for sure is my family and families like mine need more than temporary protections. We are contributing members of our society, and should not be treated as threats or targets. Enough is enough. Yet, despite the sentiments of the American people, Republicans have only continued to double down on their regressive plan to roll back reproductive freedom and strip women of their bodily autonomy. On the national scale, the same hyper-partisan Supreme Court that made the disastrous decision to overturn Roe v. Wade in 2022 could soon rule to restrict access to mifepristone — a safe, at-home abortion pill that accounts for more than half of all abortions in the U.S. That means that abortion access could be ripped away from women even in states like New York, where abortion rights are protected under state law. And Republicans’ own presidential nominee Donald Trump recently said that, if re-elected, he would allow states to monitor women’s pregnancies and prosecute women who have had abortions. Peter -

Yesterday, we launched our first ads of the campaign. But the decision to do so, at this moment, was a difficult one.

The reality is, launching this early, at the end of May – just over 5 months until the election – is a bit of a leap of faith.

On the one hand, we want to go up as soon as possible with so many undecided voters out there and Republicans starting to put out TV ads to rally voters.

On the other hand, the last thing a campaign wants to do is go up on television and come down while our potential opponents and their super PACs are on the air. There’s all kinds of data that makes clear that hurts the effectiveness of the ads.

And of course, because the vast majority of contributions will come only in the final weeks of the election – September and October – we don't have the money in the bank right now to stay up on the air between now and the time the first votes are cast.

So the bet we made, not without fiscal risk, was that supporters like you would understand the strategic choice we made, why it gives us the best chance to win, and contribute to help us fill the budget holes we have to fill in order to keep us on the air.

Peter,

As my time representing Washington's 6th Congressional District comes to a close, I want to take a moment to reflect on the values that have guided my work.

My team’s core mission has been two-fold – **to get government and the economy working better for folks in our region.**

I've worked to strengthen the middle class, ensure our veterans get the benefits they have earned and deserve, give our children a quality education, meet our commitment to our seniors, and protect the region’s rich natural heritage.

This region holds a special place in my heart. It's where I grew up, where I'm raising my own children, and where I've seen firsthand the resilience and spirit of our neck of the woods. That's why it's important to me to ensure that the next representative for this district shares our commitment to these values and has a proven track record of effectively addressing the unique needs of communities across our region.

I'm proud to support Hilary Franz for Washington's 6th Congressional District. _**Hilary's experience working with communities throughout our district and her dedication to service make her the right choice to serve as our next representative.**_

But she can't do it alone.

[_**To ensure Hilary has the resources she needs to continue fighting for our community, I'm asking for your support. [1]Powered By People

We need to make sure you saw Beto’s email yesterday. Texas Republicans
have adopted a new, extreme platform at their state convention.

Please read Beto’s email below on the seriousness of what Texas
Republican’s are pushing for and then [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240529.wv03g6&refcode=ema20240529-239611&t=1001&akid=239611%2E444211%2EBgzgVP ]make a contribution to support
our work to elect Democrats in Texas.

Thank you,

Team Powered by People

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Message from Beto, sent 5/28

Texas Republicans just adopted a new platform at their state convention
that pushes their radical, anti-democracy agenda to new extremes.
(Remember, these are the guys who decided to remove this clause from their
platform last year: "The Republican Party of Texas will have no
association whatsoever with any individual or organization that is known
to espouse anti-Semitism, pro-Nazi sympathies, or Holocaust denial.")

If enacted through legislation, as their members have committed to do,
their new plan will require the Bible to be taught in public schools and
will fuel new attacks on reproductive healthcare and the LGBTQ community.

But perhaps most alarmingly, the Texas GOP platform calls for new laws
that will no longer allow the winner of the popular vote in Texas to hold
office if they don’t also win a majority of Texas counties.

Republicans clearly understand that it is only a matter of time before
Democrats win statewide. And they are trying to change the rules of our
elections before that can happen.

Their anxiety is reflected by the trajectory of change in Texas. Barack
Obama lost the state by 16 points in 2012. Four years later, Hillary
Clinton lost by 9. In 2020, Joe Biden lost Texas by a little more than 5
percent. Texas is turning blue faster than any other battleground state in
the country.

Realizing the inevitable, Republicans have done everything they can to
entrench themselves in power by reducing voting rights, including:
racially gerrymandering the state, closing hundreds of polling places,
imposing the harshest voter ID law in the country and targeting Harris
County for the most intense suppression and intimidation campaign in the
country. This is in a state that already lacks online voter registration,
same-day voter registration or automatic voter registration.

In fact, they’ve made Texas the toughest state in the nation in which to
vote or to register to vote.

But they fear that even these extreme measures won’t be enough to stop
Democrats from winning, so they’re taking the extraordinary step of trying
to decide statewide elections not on the popular vote but on the number of
counties won. You can imagine a Democrat running up big margins in Harris,
Dallas, Travis, El Paso, Bexar and Hidalgo and winning suburban
strongholds like Hays and Williamson too, leading to a clear majority on
election night. But under these proposed Republican rules, if the Democrat
doesn’t win a majority of the smaller and more rural counties (like
Loving, Texas: population 64), they would be denied victory.

Doesn’t sound much like much of a democracy does it?

That’s why we’re doing the work to defeat Republicans and elect Democrats
at all levels of government. We need pro-democracy, pro-voting rights wins
up and down the ballot and the best way to get there is to add more
Democrats to the rolls and make sure they turn out.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240529.wv03g6&refcode=ema20240529-239611&t=1002&akid=239611%2E444211%2EBgzgVP ]Please support our work to reach, register and stay in touch with the
hundreds of thousands of eligible Democrats in Texas who represent the
margin of victory in the most important state to win in America.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240529.wv03g6&refcode=ema20240529-239611&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=239611%2E444211%2EBgzgVP ]DONATE $3

It’s tough, necessary work – and it’s the key to keeping this state and
our country a democracy.

Thank you,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=239611%2E444211%2EBgzgVP

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, just two
days ago, the Israeli military launched airstrikes on a tent camp of
displaced Palestinians in Rafah — killing 45 innocent people, including
many women and children. It’s one of the single deadliest attacks on the
Palestinian people during Israel’s 8-month onslaught.

What more needs to happen for Congress and Biden to stop sending bombs and
taxpayer dollars to support these atrocities?

While Netanyahu claimed the bombing was a mistake, Rep. Rashida Tlaib
called the attack intentional. “You don’t accidentally kill massive
amounts of children and their families over and over again and get to say,
‘It was a mistake,’” said Tlaib, the only Palestinian-American in
Congress.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17892?t=1011&akid=6081%2E5885482%2E-8B1p5 ][IMG]

If Congress and Biden continue turning their backs, more Palestinians and
aid workers will be killed by the Israeli military’s American-made bombs.

invasion of Rafah. President Biden has warned Israel too. But he keeps

Netanyahu has created a humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza — one that has

If America claims to be the leader of the free world, there’s clear action

I’m a Marine Corps veteran, mayor of my hometown of Stockton, a proud father & husband, and I’m running to rescue American families and workers from Washington D.C.’s broken politics. | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=83dae376a76e44cb90b4035658eb4961&_e=Y3WuU8vgj3swZpEA0_qgvx1xsmEgsNfgGulv644POlrnT3OGTM3-S7GyDnwj5o2FoVrpbDezlyz9rtfjkspLCk4nSlTo3y1UQR_1lViqYGTVLgyEEC03dDaAm6HavJXvbj056YNEsTZL_L3XKjFrd446vyi1rKhMx6TXf0aTE7QaKXScPejoAGb9JoojB4OlvM8REWQTvBe3swwIaX3LNXofWGffvVDgrvtN_jQKt-_s61GC9k-HKMsIQjZwFtdVyKWlO7SRnIFf1g1TH3cnQVJOGXREiN-qt_V8J-U20l1aTUyD-g6jPtgoCFkcdRH62jhq6yN4gglIptdFd-iW3n91FDzPJlsTazH1mGy0DHcdQwkCfeAO_xqSNA4mDpLh0OTIL_D9fRvL4EJa-u7QIQ%3D%3D)
Peter,

I’m Kevin Lincoln, the conservative Republican who is running to defeat leftist Josh Harder in California’s highly-targeted 9th Congressional District – _one of the most competitive House races in the country._

**I’m a Marine Corps veteran, mayor of my hometown of Stockton, a proud father & husband, and I’m running to rescue American families and workers from Washington D.C.’s broken politics.**

[ ** Send a Marine & Mayor to Congress ➞ **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=83dae376a76e44cb90b4035658eb4961&_e=Y3WuU8vgj3swZpEA0_qgvx1xsmEgsNfgGulv644POlrnT3OGTM3-S7GyDnwj5o2FoVrpbDezlyz9rtfjkspLCk4nSlTo3y1UQR_1lViqYGTVLgyEEC03dDaAm6HavJXvbj056YNEsTZL_L3XKjFrd446vyi1rKhMx6TXf0aTE7QaKXScPejoAGb9JoojB4OlvM8REWQTvBe3swwIaX3LNXofWGffvVDgrvtN_jQKt-8use3YIm-DwOxIIYr2PR8eQeDq3Hbipu7Rouwyty8j2wdME0_t78IHOMEH1-kmPbTF8zclK9LWb7tdw_OJDv7trkhR9k6WM7H-x3ehgOThv3JKAHy23G3NKXg2xuqvGn0P8INZoH_2_MU7iZTIkTXvyUA-GB8yr9foOe4m2WTgXQ%3D%3D)
Service has always defined my life. I joined the United States Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer.

After 9/11, I was assigned to Marine One to serve and protect the President of the United States.

When I completed my military service, I graduated from college while working full time and raising a family. But my urge to serve hadn’t gone. I continued to serve my community as a pastor and as a non-profit leader.

**Now, one of the greatest honors of my life is being able to serve as the Mayor of my hometown of Stockton, California.**

As Mayor, my team and I have revitalized our local economy, attracted businesses that have created jobs, balanced our budget, tackled homelessness, and reduced violent crime.

America as a whole is suffering these same problems, but the politicians in the White House and Congress don’t have what it takes to fix them.

**I do, and that’s why I’m running for Congress. My country needs me again, and I’m ready to serve.**

[**Will you send in a Marine and mayor to fix Washington’s broken politics and get our country back on track by supporting my campaign with a $5, $10 or $15 contribution today?**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=83dae376a76e44cb90b4035658eb4961&_e=Y3WuU8vgj3swZpEA0_qgvx1xsmEgsNfgGulv644POlrnT3OGTM3-S7GyDnwj5o2FoVrpbDezlyz9rtfjkspLCk4nSlTo3y1UQR_1lViqYGTVLgyEEC03dDaAm6HavJXvbj056YNEsTZL_L3XKjFrd446vyi1rKhMx6TXf0aTE7QaKXScPejoAGb9JoojB4OlvM8REWQTvBe3swwIaX3LNXofWGffvVDgrvtN_jQKt-92r0aEmkDdQknNZnijC4yfuPiYZQnuHk2ShkHJcuJU1Ob7dVr6ilZQ877aWbekQUdRtA1as-IM5vA0Gw5eUAkIIIqtwozTkUk3ggxNVfesuvLDf_wkRCrsUlMHjwEjoH5gOW3Q0JdiX0GBN2Tj6qIDuFhVVamSQj2bbYupaB_A0A%3D%3D)

[ ** Send a Marine & Mayor to Congress ➞ **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=83dae376a76e44cb90b4035658eb4961&_e=Y3WuU8vgj3swZpEA0_qgvx1xsmEgsNfgGulv644POlrnT3OGTM3-S7GyDnwj5o2FoVrpbDezlyz9rtfjkspLCk4nSlTo3y1UQR_1lViqYGTVLgyEEC03dDaAm6HavJXvbj056YNEsTZL_L3XKjFrd446vyi1rKhMx6TXf0aTE7QaKXScPejoAGb9JoojB4OlvM8REWQTvBe3swwIaX3LNXofWGffvVDgrvtN_jQKt-_fgePzshsm97lPVuRQQXjOKD1QDwQcPFH-La1Wvk_JHuP4x5-EO1a15ztn7AdQ9fVDB7xfH5UuSArBN2de2CQyoAMEPfv7GFeVMfWJdpqwCminGMCDAs-xja_Isl1FHliP-AL-rQ2Z23zcOa9U8IGrJ2M3p2pBxmzaLRchL1AKOQ%3D%3D)
Career politicians like Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi and Josh Harder have created the mess we’re in, so why would we think they could get us out of it?

We need to get inflation under control, revive our economy, reprioritize public safety, support our veterans, and make the politicians in Washington D.C. work for and serve the American people once again.

subject: FWD: Can Sarah call you?
body:
Pitch in to get on the list!
#
Did you see this email from Sarah on Friday?
It’s not too late to get on the list of people Sarah might call. [**Make a donation of any amount toward our end-of-month fundraising goal and we will add you to the list!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?refcode=em20240529-1-522&amount=5&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?refcode=em20240529-1-522&amount=5&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
On Friday, our end-of-month fundraising deadline will close and we need all the help we can get to reach our $10,000 goal.
As we enter the homestretch of our primary election, we can’t miss this fundraising goal.
By making a donation today, you will automatically get on the list of supporters Sarah might call — and you’ll help ensure we have the resources to kick our campaign into high gear.
[**So will you win with us and make a $5 donation right now? We’re counting on you!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?refcode=em20240529-1-522&amount=5&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?amount=5&refcode=em20240529-1-522&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)**
Thank you for all that you do,
Team McBride
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Sarah McBride
Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
Subject: I might give you a call:
_
Hey,
I’ve always said campaigns are conversations, and I’m proud to have had so many incredible discussions with folks up and down Delaware.
**But, I want to talk with you.**
So I made a deal with my team: Next Friday marks an important end-of-month fundraising deadline, and as a way of saying thanks, I’ll call as many supporters who pitch in as I can!
[**So before you log off for the holiday weekend, will you chip in $5 or any amount? If you do, you might receive a call from me soon!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?refcode=em20240529-1-522&amount=5&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?amount=5&refcode=em20240529-1-522&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)**
With your help, we’re building a historic campaign for Congress that brings in the voices of workers, families, and all of our communities.
As we enter the home stretch of our primary campaign, your grassroots donations before our May deadline will help us keep our momentum, have even more conversations with voters, and win.
That’s why I want to speak with and thank grassroots supporters like you personally.
[**So, if you want to get on the list, click here and pitch in a donation of any amount before our end-of-month deadline next Friday.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?refcode=em20240529-1-522&amount=5&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240529?amount=5&refcode=em20240529-1-522&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)**
Hope to talk soon!
Sarah McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240529-1&t=1&refcode2=522_21716_qQv0q4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=2&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=3&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=522%2E21716%2EqQv0q4)

Patriot,

If you're getting this email, it's because I believe that you are a member of the America First movement and that you agree with me on one critical issue:

**Joe Biden is harming our nation.**

I'm reaching out to members of our community because I know that things look bleak right now across the board — high inflation, chaotic college protests, rising antisemitism, foolish federal funding bills, attacks on the American dream — the list goes on.

We know that **Joe Biden lost his backbone a long time ago.**

The duty of the President of the United States is to project strength and act quickly to stop all threats to the American people.

Yet, Joe Biden continues to project _weakness_ by:

* Allowing radical antisemitism to fester all over college campuses
* Standing by while our border is overrun by criminals and terrorists
* Wrecking our economy with skyrocketing inflation
* Spending American tax dollars on wasteful foreign projects

**The bottom line is Joe Biden is bending over backward for everything except America's public safety.**

**The result:** A weak and woke America that is vulnerable to attacks from foreign threats and radicals in our own country.

This is the exact opposite of what America needs from our leader.

**America is not a weak or lawless nation! We are the land of the free and the home of the brave — _it's time we start acting like it again!_ **

If you agree with me that we need to intervene before it's too late and Joe Biden runs our nation into the ground, **[I need you on my team](https://click.conservativeinamerica.com/u/click?_t=f7e0cf91482847a4a92b501b335089ff&_m=f589e7c60219471494630391c58f2f08&_e=CTYXjA6bvO4tez7lT7oH0yRLdOF_5AOdYkV_cGgOQWnML8OicFOeuBABg6dgMlK4X7bcowKkA6jUKJqDyuy3jXfXJpXxEIzP5LWV9j_dQkfP2J0YSBqunSV6zNIxE_QFP2a7HdMSINQrPYdJw1_Apbhcs9GT-Ls0Uq3Oh4j8Bp7SJwH_Uiq5uhEtqe6FJCmlNj7SZkMg7FZPattQdd6Apl0MUeQprRpeJFulOBn496_g8M7J9LeUW72qaX0yy1d1rEqW7vQX9nfikeWA1xnJyMS2mh_e4JJd0SY8CgeHhtwuyVFrlVGw5Er1CDDW3NqAYAhUy7HfKKzxwSJqngzJTRu4v9Fnl5FXPf4_CNKVmTIPWOBE8ghDB2c-z7wJuh-_).**

Serving in the U.S. Army I learned the power of having a strong team that you can rely on. Heck, I wouldn't even be here today if it wasn't for my brothers and sisters in arms rushing to haul me out after my legs were blown off in a terrorist bomb explosion.

All of this to say — we can't rely on Joe Biden, but I feel like I can count on you.

If you want to secure the future of our country, **[please join me today](https://click.conservativeinamerica.com/u/click?_t=f7e0cf91482847a4a92b501b335089ff&_m=f589e7c60219471494630391c58f2f08&_e=CTYXjA6bvO4tez7lT7oH0yRLdOF_5AOdYkV_cGgOQWnML8OicFOeuBABg6dgMlK4X7bcowKkA6jUKJqDyuy3jXfXJpXxEIzP5LWV9j_dQkfP2J0YSBqunSV6zNIxE_QFP2a7HdMSINQrPYdJw1_Apbhcs9GT-Ls0Uq3Oh4j8Bp7SJwH_Uiq5uhEtqe6FJCmlNj7SZkMg7FZPattQdd6Apl0MUeQprRpeJFulOBn496-KHu2NBd6Oa1RoUw-r-DE9t_bFW9vIDAT3iXwiV7Rxfol326MKx_T6VQdC-kvggWwNpouRWTxVBqTDRHtODoxZJ4ldUCafsQGeCKKnXFRqluzMB662bNqQOIjQLyR3NzWMufJhy-ajGZkklZM8JvMb).**

subject: A really, really tough choice
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We’ve gone up with a huge, historic advertising reservation in Arizona — $19 million in the home stretch. We did that based on our fundraising data so far, and what we know Kari Lake and the GOP are going to be spending against us.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben. It’s been clear to me from the very beginning that this was a special team.
I’m counting on that now, because we just had to make an incredibly tough choice.
We’ve gone up with a huge, historic advertising reservation in Arizona — $19 million in the home stretch. We did that based on our fundraising data so far, and what we know Kari Lake and the GOP are going to be spending against us. It was a tough decision to make, and it put a big hole in our budget.
If we’re going to have any shot at victory in Arizona, any shot at defeating Lake and Trump, we have to spend that much (and more). But there is no guarantee that we’ll raise the resources we need to pay for it. And since we made those reservations, our fundraising has plummeted.
It’s bad news, and the timing is absolutely terrible.
I’m coming to you with this information because you’ve always shown up when I needed you. I’m hoping you’ll have my back right now, because we’re just a couple days from our May deadline and we’re extremely far behind on our progress to goal.
[**I need you. There’s no other way to put it. Please, make a donation to my campaign and help us close our budget gap. Chip in whatever you can. Friends,

You know the stakes. You know I’m running in a swing seat. It’s a majority maker with more registered independent voters than any district in New York State. We can flip this seat from red to blue if Democrats fire up the base and then reach beyond it to form the broadest possible patriotic coalition to defeat Donald Trump and his far-right flunkies in Congress.

That’s exactly what our campaign is doing right now. Democrats across the district are uniting to support our campaign. It’s why six of the eight town committees in the district and nearly every elected Democrat in the district have endorsed me.

That’s the fight. We’re in the final stretch here, with barely four weeks to go until the primary election. My opponent is self-funding with millions of dollars. Can you pitch in before the end of the month and make sure we have the resources we need to play offense and communicate my message to voters? -John

Fellow American,

[](http://links.gopstateallies.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=fae2149198364716a82f9570d8cdf474&_e=pMtcuzT8Sn4cPiw2T3On_ei-D5AUV2gR9ZDj0ljXXbttvLJK5M5JcIWg154SrJL1wZThcZca2RO9BmSQSK6AWbyQO6hcI2k2RWtQCsGu1sVa2PporG18za21p5fxxWHLH7MQlvqN5ZJSJ25PhTtfGKlgOPmoQdniWlT5QZrfV0cU3fKR6LCCctj6VucdEF4EESj-96pY8Be0BJ7BIpDvFAIhTmLBB6IXRGtpYgrlSIPRKb7vdO7O29_4B-nrKiHFLMwAMswzBiGjFyVnK-M_qhRQDk6Q73uWsA6tPePwuFPy2PnxVW53lSKcES6JrOR-208K0WGh2bZdQq-0T_g0MbwUcx3_OgkToNCPp8HyGM4fER4qu7zYWBMD3MNFhjTyFOqeCdPdxPRT6iEKEfEc6JdqYX2f2MgCIqnegDqziEI%3D) Yes. I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism.

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio.

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._
