Derek, Here at the DNC, we’re committed to electing Democrats **up and down the ballot, from school board to the White House.** That means working closely with our state parties all over the country to ensure they have the resources they need to win elections year in and year out. From innovative organizing to state-of-the-art data and technology and voter protection programs, your support funds critical initiatives that help empower state parties nationwide. [If you’re ready to pitch in so we can continue this important work, you can donate here. ](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtr6i0NfiYyLJ8wy5K3FsOoEfDFlYKtEmR-Pm-AvEuATkZGdHF9rvhSP-rpQaEyhksrFMEfoOisddMB6HybY26oJJTjTB89xjCBmw6WSwty7bhvraj5N16vhC1y6MA4JJeFb2YO-E6gwxzqhjYwmmytyhA1krAGucB5rV864tE8a7rAmUksu0eQk8CAa5UIbofDjInrR-UEDAMu7G182bmZewJyVQOEHey4uobQqiveVv2VoA8AenAl2Nz0nVBstHek6g7G1TKbukUB_yq57xpJn-31104nXdoOgFg37udgugYzF0DT4THQ5T-Baa0mKdLGD9rkPCAdmbpFJIpG7WKp80jMDHN5ZMKGPOF6Nwz0JAA3Kow9TmfafZ9SqfHgk7x/46r/l26f5hkQQfKtvh3BUsxLzg/h0/h001.VFBagBl_yCyedQ9EWcyM0mmSw9JXTFBY-eVwcJ0rUC8) Meanwhile, Republican state parties remain in turmoil. That’s why right now, it’s so important we take advantage of the head start many of our state parties have, and keep building the infrastructure and funding to ensure Democratic victories. Just look at what Democrats were able to accomplish in 2023 thanks to strong investments from this team in state parties nationwide:
* In **Virginia** , Democrats flipped the state House and retook control of the general assembly.
* In **Kentucky** , Democrats reelected Governor Andy Beshear in a red state.
* In **Ohio** , Democrats voted to enshrine abortion access in the state constitution.

None of these victories would have been possible without the work of our state parties and the support from Democrats like you. That’s why it’s so important we ensure our state parties have the resources they need to build on these victories in 2024. Ryan Mackenzie for U.S. Congress | | | | |
---
| Friends,
This Memorial Day weekend, I had the honor of participating in two events recognizing our fallen heroes - the brave men and women of our armed forces who gave the ultimate sacrifice to defend our freedoms. In addition to Memorial Day activities, I hope that you had a safe and enjoyable weekend with your friends and family.
Here’s what #TeamMackenzie has been up to over the last week:
* Visit from Speaker Johnson
* Working all over
* Remembering the Fallen

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out to info@mackenzieforcongress.com.
All the Best,
---
|
---
| **Speaker Johnson Visits the Lehigh Valley**
In the latest reminder of the importance of the Lehigh Valley’s congressional race this year, Speaker Johnson joined us last week for several stops in the district. When we visited with local EMS members at Cetronia Ambulance Corps for National EMS Week, the Speaker thanked our EMS professionals for their work in our community. He also had a clear message for the people of the Lehigh Valley: we are on the frontline of the fight to grow the GOP majority in the house.
---
[Grow the GOP Majority](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=4efb26411b&e=5ccada9200)
| While our Republican candidates have come extremely close to knocking off Susan Wild in the past - even in difficult years for Republicans - now is the time we can win! As the Biden-Wild record continues to fall apart and our polling surges, we have our best chance ever. [Join the fight to help us flip the Lehigh Valley RED once and for all. ](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=a4f149a745&e=5ccada9200)
See more from the visit [here](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=d539718225&e=5ccada9200).
---
|
---
| **Working All Over**
The weather is heating up and so is this race. That’s why we’re working throughout the district to meet current voters and register new ones. In Carbon County, our team helped register Madison to vote. Now, she will be able to vote this year for the first time! On housing, inflation, education, and more, young people are being let down by the DC politicians. It’s time to elect a new generation of leaders who will enact policies that actually help young people get ahead: [https://www.mackenzieforcongress.com/](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=33ed14e95b&e=5ccada9200)
---
[Get the Message Out](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=f8d7522de2&e=5ccada9200)
|
---
| **Remembering the Fallen**
Memorial Day is a time to reflect on the sacrifices of those who gave everything in service to our country. I was very proud to participate in yesterday’s Memorial Day ceremonies in Macungie where I also had the privilege to thank some of our local veterans from VFW Post 9264.

After first serving as a federal law enforcement officer and then working undercover as a CIA case officer to keep our country safe, I chose to serve our country in another way: running for Congress. I wanted to use my background and experience to craft sound policy, get things done, and deliver for my community.

When I was considering running for public office, Emerge played an important role in my journey. Thanks to Emerge, I was suddenly in a room full of dedicated, determined, and strong women who were considering entering the political arena for the first time. And when I eventually made clear that I was ready to run for Congress, they didn’t hesitate. They said, _“Do it.”_

That’s what sets Emerge apart. You’re surrounded by women who are looking to get involved in their communities. These women are looking to lead — not looking to sit on the sidelines.

When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, I was proud to be the first Democrat elected to serve my Virginia district since 1968 — and I was honored to be the first-ever woman to represent my district in the U.S. House of Representatives. Emerge provided the early training that was needed to not only _run_ for office — but to _win._

And at this moment when our rights and our democracy are under attack, **we need more Democratic women at the decision-making table**. Emerge’s National Boot Camp is designed specifically for those who are running for office right now, and we need to make sure that Emerge has the resources to provide the crucial strategy and training to help more women serve their communities and defend our rights. But it takes significant resources to prepare a new cohort, and they can’t win in 2024 without your support.

I wanted to use my background and experience to craft sound policy, get things done, and deliver for my community. When I was considering running for public office, Emerge played an important role in my journey. Thanks to Emerge, I was suddenly in a room full of dedicated, determined, and strong women who were considering entering the political arena for the first time. And when I eventually made clear that I was ready to run for Congress, they didn’t hesitate. They said, “Do it.” That’s what sets Emerge apart. You’re surrounded by women who are looking to get involved in their communities. These women are looking to lead — not looking to sit on the sidelines. When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, I was proud to be the first Democrat elected to serve my Virginia district since 1968 — and I was honored to be the first-ever woman to represent my district in the U.S. House of Representatives. Emerge provided the early training that was needed to not only run for office — but to win. And at this moment when our rights and our democracy are under attack, we need more Democratic women at the decision-making table. Emerge’s National Boot Camp is designed specifically for those who are running for office right now, and we need to make sure that Emerge has the resources to provide the crucial strategy and training to help more women serve their communities and defend our rights. subject: Diagnosis: Capitalism

body:
Check-up w/ Dr. Stein: How are you doing?

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mental_health&n=1)
---
Peter,

I couldn’t let May close without talking about Mental Health Awareness Month and addressing the elephant/donkey in the room:

**_We are all suffering from late stage capitalism, and both major parties are to blame.

_** While I haven’t been a practicing physician for some years, I DID serve as a medical doctor for decades. I do not profess to be a mental health specialist, but in my time as a doctor of internal medicine I worked with patients all day long who suffered physical symptoms triggered by the emotional strain of surviving in a structurally unjust society.

This is not purely my medical experience speaking. This is the conclusion of a multitude of peer-reviewed studies by various organizations that specialize in public health – for years.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mental_health&n=2)
---
It’s not particularly surprising, is it?

When we have to work harder for less, when we have to pay more for our basic needs, when we live under the constant strain of income insecurity and housing insecurity and food insecurity...we pay a physical AND mental price for that.

Adding insult to injury is the fact that American health insurance programs consider mental health an “add-on” component and not a fundamental part of our total human wellness.

To tackle the American mental health crisis, we need a multi-tiered approach.

First, we need universal healthcare that includes comprehensive mental health services as a fundamental part of wellness.Second, we need to address the root causes contributing to the mental, emotional, and physical strain so many Americans are living with – fixing income inequality, providing housing security and guaranteeing a living wage and access to high-quality, fresh foods, green spaces, and adequate rest.

Finally, we need to commit to the kind of political change that would make these changes permanent.

Not subject to the means-testing that Democrats love. Not subject to the whims of the next despot the Republicans put in power.

Lasting, structural, social and political changes that can’t be undone by the stroke of a pen.

**[That’s what we’re fighting for with this campaign, and I need your help to get us there. We’ve overcome so many barriers together. Will you make a contribution today to make sure EVERY American has the opportunity to vote for our campaign for people, planet, and peace?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mental_health&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mental_health&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mental_health&n=4)
---
Peter, we don’t have to live this way. Whatever burdens you may be carrying in your heart, you should know that you are not alone and you do not have to shoulder that burden alone.

My wish for all of us this Mental Health Awareness Month is that we as a society will embrace solutions that provide both the immediate support people in crisis need, and the structural changes that will improve our collective emotional wellness.

You deserve to live in peace. You deserve to live in tranquility. You deserve to live without fear, anxiety, and the impending sense of gloom that capitalism imposes on us all.

I believe that world is possible. If I didn’t, I wouldn’t be running for president. And I am grateful every day for your solidarity in this fight.

Warmly,

Jill

body:
Virginia is the only remaining state in the South without an abortion ban in place.
| | |
---
Peter, when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and states across the country immediately began enacting draconian laws to control women’s bodies and choices, one thing became abundantly clear:
Reproductive freedom will be on the ballot in November.

Already we’re seeing so many shameful and heartbreaking impacts of extreme abortion bans — the rising infant mortality rate in Texas, the seventh-grader forced to become a mom in Mississippi. And safe havens for reproductive rights are becoming fewer and farther between:
**Right now, Virginia is the _only remaining state in the South without an abortion ban in place._**
We’ve got to fight these unjust restrictions at the state level and in the courts, and there are activists on the ground across the country who are doing just that. But there’s one clear action that we can and must take at the federal level if we want to ensure women have bodily autonomy: Congress must codify the protections of _Roe_ into federal law.

I’m prepared to do that — I introduced the bipartisan Reproductive Freedom for All Act, and I’m pushing hard to get it passed.
**But I’m up for reelection this year, so if I’m going to keep fighting for reproductive freedom, I need to hold on to my seat — and Democrats need to hold on to our majority.**

This is why we are strategically investing in key races and candidates across our state, and we want to talk with you about how you can make a difference. We’re pouring every dollar we raise into these targeted seats. We need your insights and investment so please come out and join me and several of my caucus colleagues on Wednesday, June 12th for cocktails and conversation. Click here to add your name to the host committee or to purchase tickets . [] After another brutal legislative session, I’m looking forward to seeing my longtime friends and Democratic allies in Nashville soon. subject: Climate change is the greatest threat to humanity – But it isn’t too late to act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Defeat Republicans PAC (www
body:
Our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. |
---
_Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment)._

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85878417/476147949/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240529_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYjQxODhmLTBiMWUtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5B-zplcloGSpoqciQ4lReBi7IW-bM50s0I8Dfs7xnpk=)

Peter – I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years.

**I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival.**

But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. **I am still an optimist.**

It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years.

**I’m humbly asking:** [_Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Defeat Republicans ahead of their deadline at the end of the month? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85878419/476147954/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240529_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYjQxODhmLTBiMWUtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5B-zplcloGSpoqciQ4lReBi7IW-bM50s0I8Dfs7xnpk=)

You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world.

So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect.

**It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more.**

But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry.

**This is the most pivotal election for climate to date.** My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country.

**Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act:** [_Join me in supporting 314 Action and Defeat Republicans. Let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85878422/476147956/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240529_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYjQxODhmLTBiMWUtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5B-zplcloGSpoqciQ4lReBi7IW-bM50s0I8Dfs7xnpk=)

clean_body: Our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). = Peter – I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: = You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. Our window to act is closing. **Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

He built a conservative, pro-family voting record, and authored an alternative state budget that balanced without raising taxes. Friends --
While I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-may24.waY6cu&refcode=em240529-2-sa&t=3&akid=1482%2E135344%2EPPxllu)**

Peter, **I am so excited to be OFFICIALLY endorsed by President Trump!**

His support means the world to me, and I know that together, we can bring back America into greatness.

For me, this endorsement is more than just politics, it’s personal.

You see, my family and I came to America with little besides the clothes on our backs. We escaped Communist Vietnam after being put on a kill list, and when we had nothing left, America welcomed us with open arms.

My family came to America the legal way. We worked hard despite barely knowing a word of English, and we were able to make it in the greatest country on Earth.

**We’re living proof of the same American dream President Trump and Republicans are working hard to protect.**

After graduating from the top high school in America, I earned an appointment to the Naval Academy and went on to serve on the front lines of combat for 25 years. I fought in Iraq, Afghanistan and Somalia taking on some of the world’s most dangerous terrorists.

At times, it was definitely a lot, but I was never scared because I knew I was fighting for the country that gave me everything.

**Now, Democrats like Joe Biden are trying to take the freedoms that I fought to preserve. The freedoms that my family came here for.**

He’s replacing our justice system with a kangaroo court that looks more like communist Vietnam than the United States of America. He’s putting illegal immigrants who want to do nothing but break our laws over veterans who put their lives on the line for this country. _And he’s doing it all on your dime._

The only way we can TRULY defend the country I fought for is by re-electing President Trump and taking back the Senate, and we can’t do either without your help.

clean_body: | | | Peter, I am so excited to be OFFICIALLY endorsed by President Trump! His support means the world to me, and I know that together, we can bring back America into greatness. For me, this endorsement is more than just politics, it’s personal. You see, my family and I came to America with little besides the clothes on our backs. We escaped Communist Vietnam after being put on a kill list, and when we had nothing left, America welcomed us with open arms. My family came to America the legal way. We worked hard despite barely knowing a word of English, and we were able to make it in the greatest country on Earth. We’re living proof of the same American dream President Trump and Republicans are working hard to protect. After graduating from the top high school in America, I earned an appointment to the Naval Academy and went on to serve on the front lines of combat for 25 years. I fought in Iraq, Afghanistan and Somalia taking on some of the world’s most dangerous terrorists. At times, it was definitely a lot, but I was never scared because I knew I was fighting for the country that gave me everything. Now, Democrats like Joe Biden are trying to take the freedoms that I fought to preserve. The freedoms that my family came here for. He’s replacing our justice system with a kangaroo court that looks more like communist Vietnam than the United States of America. He’s putting illegal immigrants who want to do nothing but break our laws over veterans who put their lives on the line for this country. And he’s doing it all on your dime. The only way we can TRULY defend the country I fought for is by re-electing President Trump and taking back the Senate, and we can’t do either without your help. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

#

Let me get this straight, Peter: First, we hear stories about Supreme Court justices like Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito being wined and dined by conservative billionaires and prominent right-wing activists, some of whom had business before the Court. Then, we hear that despite Clarence Thomas’s wife, Ginni, playing an active role in Donald Trump’s plot to overturn the 2020 election, Justice Thomas has refused to recuse himself from cases concerning the former president. **And now, we learn that Justice Alito was flying an overtly political symbol on a flag outside his home, right after January 6?** Enough. This is exactly why I am fighting for a rigorous code of conduct for all Supreme Court justices. It is why I am fighting for transparency at the Court. And it is why we should all be concerned that a GOP-led Senate would continue to cause Americans to lose all faith in the Court by filling it with ideologically-motivated judges. ### Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin
---
Hi friend, it’s Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, and Tammy Baldwin. Election experts agree that Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin could determine control of the Senate this year.
That means if any one of us loses this November, it’s almost guaranteed that the GOP will reclaim the Senate majority and enable Republicans to enact their dangerous far-right agenda**. We can’t let that happen.** Protecting our seats won’t be easy. Each of us are running against mega-millionaire opponents Mitch McConnell personally handpicked to unseat us, and dark money groups are dumping hundreds of millions of dollars into our races to attack our campaigns.
All four of us are facing our toughest reelection fight yet.
